KSCSTE.technology_name: Cryopreservation Protocol for Pollen and Spores
KSCSTE.institution: KSCSTE- Malabar Botanical Garden & Institute for Plant Sciences (MBGIPS)
KSCSTE.secondary_sector: Forestry & Biodiversity , Pharmaceuticals & Nutraceuticals
KSCSTE.problem_solved: Securing the long-term viability, genetic stability, and sustainable sourcing of high-value plant species.
KSCSTE.description: A cryopreservation protocol developed to secure the long-term viability of pollen and spores from high-value plant species, ensuring genetic stability and successful post-thaw recovery. The protocol covers medicinal, ornamental, and ecologically important plants, including ferns (e.g., Asplenium nidus), angiosperms (e.g., Clitoria ternatea), Nymphaea, Crinum, Costus, and orchid varieties. It supports the sustainable sourcing of elite planting materials, providing consistent inputs for the herbal, pharmaceutical, and floriculture sectors.
KSCSTE.applications_&_industry_standard:
• Sustainable sourcing of elite planting material for pharmaceutical and herbal sectors

• Consistent, high-quality inputs for the wellness and antioxidant-rich food industries

• Supply of cryo-banked ornamental plants (Nymphaea, orchids, ferns) for the floriculture market

• Long-term biodiversity conservation and genetic banking of high-value plant species
KSCSTE.contact_person: Dr. Manjula K M & Dr. N S Pradeep
KSCSTE.key_benefits_&_value_proposition:
• Secures long-term viability and successful post-thaw recovery of pollen and spores

• Ensures genetic stability of high-value medicinal and ornamental plants

• Provides scalable solutions for consistent input to herbal and wellness industries

KSCSTE.technology_name: Bark Stripping Equipment for Jiggat-Yielding Plants
KSCSTE.institution: KSCSTE- Kerala Forest Research Institute (KFRI)
KSCSTE.secondary_sector: Consumer Goods & Crafts, Rural Livelihoods & Skill Development, Forestry & Biodiversity
KSCSTE.problem_solved: Traditional manual Jiggat bark harvesting using chisels damages the tree's vascular cambium, causing wilting and eventual death.
KSCSTE.description: A compact bark stripping tool developed to harvest Jiggat—a natural binding agent used in agarbatti (incense stick) production. Conventional manual extraction using chisels damages the tree's vascular cambium, leading to wilting and death. This device enables precise, controlled bark removal while keeping the inner regenerative tissues intact. It reduces physical strain on workers, improves consistency in bark yield, and promotes natural tree regeneration, offering a sustainable alternative for community and commercial non-timber forest product harvesting.
KSCSTE.applications_&_industry_standard:
• Sustainable harvesting of Jiggat bark for the agarbatti (incense stick) manufacturing industry

• Deployment by tribal and rural communities for non-timber forest product extraction

• Adoption by forestry departments for conservation-friendly resource management

• Commercial scaling of natural binding agent production
KSCSTE.key_benefits_&_value_proposition:
• Prevents damage to the vascular cambium, promoting natural tree regeneration

• Reduces physical strain on harvesting workers compared to manual chiseling

• Improves the consistency of bark yield compared to traditional methods

KSCSTE.technology_name: Aqua Flora-Infuse: Caffeine-Free Herbal Beverage
KSCSTE.institution: KSCSTE- Malabar Botanical Garden & Institute for Plant Sciences (MBGIPS)
KSCSTE.secondary_sector: Consumer Goods & Crafts, Pharmaceuticals & Nutraceuticals
KSCSTE.problem_solved: Addresses the consumer demand for clean-label, caffeine-free functional beverages with natural botanical and wellness properties.
KSCSTE.description: Aqua Flora-Infuse is a caffeine-free herbal drink formulation crafted from a curated mix of medicinal plants, primarily Nelumbo nucifera (lotus) and Clitoria ternatea. Developed using a gentle drying technique, the process preserves essential photoactives and floral aromas without synthetic additives. Lotus aids in relaxation and detoxification, while Clitoria ternatea provides natural color, rich anthocyanin content, and supports cognitive function. Packaged in ready-to-use tea bags, the formulation targets the clean-label, functional beverage market by combining traditional botanical ingredients with eco-friendly processing.
KSCSTE.applications_&_industry_standard:
• Commercial production of clean-label, functional herbal beverages

• Adoption by nutraceutical brands for wellness product lines

• Integration into Ayurveda-based product portfolios

• Retail distribution through premium wellness stores and export markets
KSCSTE.contact_person: Dr. Manjula K M & Dr. Hareesh V S
KSCSTE.key_benefits_&_value_proposition:
• Preserves essential photoactives and floral aromas using gentle drying techniques

• Contains zero caffeine or synthetic additives

• Provides natural color and rich anthocyanin content from Clitoria ternatea

• Available in ready-to-use tea bags for immediate consumer use

KSCSTE.technology_name: LAMP Diagnostic Kit for Sandalwood Spike Disease: Field-Deployable Diagnostic Tool
KSCSTE.institution: KSCSTE- Kerala Forest Research Institute (KFRI)
KSCSTE.secondary_sector: Genetic & Molecular Research Tools, Crop Protection & Disease Management, Forestry & Biodiversity
KSCSTE.problem_solved: Existing Sandalwood Spike Disease detection methods are lab-dependent, time-consuming, and unsuitable for rapid, large-scale field screening.
KSCSTE.description: Sandalwood Spike Disease (SSD), caused by phytoplasma, is a severe threat to Indian sandalwood, leading to tree death within 1-2 years. Traditional detection methods like PCR are lab-dependent and unsuitable for large-scale screening. This innovation is a field-deployable LAMP-based diagnostic kit that is 100x more sensitive than PCR for rapid SSD detection. It enables early identification in symptomatic and asymptomatic trees, insect vectors, and reservoir hosts, supporting epidemiological mapping and integrated pest management strategies.
KSCSTE.applications_&_industry_standard:
• Rapid, field-level screening of sandalwood trees by forest departments and plantation managers

• Epidemiological mapping and identification of disease transmission agents

• Integration into integrated pest management strategies for commercial sandalwood cultivation

• Early pathogen detection deployment in agricultural diagnostic laboratories
KSCSTE.key_benefits_&_value_proposition:
• Enables field-deployable, rapid detection of Sandalwood Spike Disease

• Provides 100x greater sensitivity than traditional PCR methods

• Identifies the disease in both symptomatic and asymptomatic trees, insect vectors, and reservoir hosts

KSCSTE.technology_name: Decision Support System for Soil Erosion: Web-Based Digital Tool
KSCSTE.institution: KSCSTE- Centre for Water Resources Development and Management (CWRDM)
KSCSTE.secondary_sector: GIS & Geospatial Systems, Soil Health & Fertility, Water Resource Management
KSCSTE.technology_type: Software/Digital Platform, Database/GIS System, Decision-Support/Analytical Tool
KSCSTE.problem_solved: Widespread challenge of soil erosion in hilly, high-rainfall regions requiring localized, science-backed mitigation planning.
KSCSTE.description: The Decision Support System (DSS) for Soil Erosion is a freely accessible, web-based digital tool tailored for hilly, high-rainfall regions. It transforms complex geospatial data—integrating specific data on rainfall, land use, and topography—into accessible maps. Users can zoom into specific Panchayats to view erosion risk levels and receive customized mitigation suggestions, such as vegetative cover, contour bunds, or drainage structures. The tool requires no login or specialized software, supporting grassroots planning, watershed development, and programs like MGNREGS.
KSCSTE.applications_&_industry_standard:
• Grassroots-level planning for soil and water conservation by government bodies and Panchayats

• Integration into official watershed development and MGNREGS programs

• Environmental governance and land-use planning by NGOs and researchers

• Deployment as a scalable geospatial model for other high-rainfall or hilly topographies
KSCSTE.key_benefits_&_value_proposition:
• Provides instant, hyperlocal erosion risk levels from low to very high at the Panchayat level

• Offers customized mitigation suggestions like vegetative cover, contour bunds, and drainage structures

• Integrates specific local data on rainfall, land use, and topography unlike generic national models

• Freely accessible online without requiring login or specialized software

KSCSTE.technology_name: Plant Tissue Culture Protocols for High-Value Crops: Disease-Free Mass Propagation Method
KSCSTE.institution: KSCSTE- Jawaharlal Nehru Tropical Botanic Garden & Research Institute (JNTBGRI)
KSCSTE.secondary_sector: Forestry & Biodiversity , Pharmaceuticals & Nutraceuticals, Genetic & Molecular Research Tools
KSCSTE.problem_solved: Absence of standardized mass propagation protocols and clean planting stock for emerging, rare, and high-value plant species.
KSCSTE.description: Jawaharlal Nehru Tropical Botanic Garden & Research Institute (JNTBGRI) has developed standardized plant tissue culture protocols for the mass propagation of high-value crops, including banana, orchids, anthuriums, and medicinal plants. This technology delivers high-quality, disease-free, and true-to-type planting material. It addresses the global demand for clean planting stock by providing a scalable and sustainable method for the mass propagation of rare, high-value, and endangered species. The protocols are designed to support the pharmaceuticals, cosmetics, herbal wellness, horticulture, and biodiversity conservation sectors.
KSCSTE.applications_&_industry_standard:
• Mass propagation of disease-free planting material for the horticulture and agriculture sectors

• Cultivation of standardized medicinal plants for pharmaceuticals, cosmetics, and herbal wellness industries

• Biodiversity conservation and reforestation through the mass propagation of rare and endangered species

• Commercial nursery operations and rural entrepreneurship via scalable tissue culture deployment
KSCSTE.key_benefits_&_value_proposition:
• Delivers high-quality, disease-free, and true-to-type planting material

• Enables scalable mass propagation of rare, high-value, and endangered plant species

• Provides a sustainable solution to meet the growing global demand for clean planting stock

KSCSTE.technology_name: Endemic Species Conservation with Ecological Niche Modelling (ENM): Habitat Suitability Mapping Tool
KSCSTE.institution: KSCSTE- Malabar Botanical Garden & Institute for Plant Sciences (MBGIPS)
KSCSTE.secondary_sector: Forestry & Biodiversity , GIS & Geospatial Systems,  Environmental Governance & Planning
KSCSTE.problem_solved: Identifying suitable habitats for the translocation of endemic plant species that have narrow distributions and poor natural dispersal mechanisms.
KSCSTE.description: This study applies a Maxent-based Ecological Niche Modelling (ENM) framework to map habitat suitability for Crinum malabaricum, an endangered plant endemic to the Malabar Plains of the Western Ghats. By evaluating 21 bioclimatic and topographic variables, the model identifies key environmental predictors—specifically precipitation and mean temperature of the driest quarter. It successfully mapped 2,393 km² of highly suitable habitat (suitability index ≥ 0.85), which is significantly larger than the species' current extent of occurrence (283 km²), guiding the field selection of ten optimal translocation sites.
KSCSTE.applications_&_industry_standard:
• Guiding target translocations and ecological restoration initiatives for forest departments and environmental conservation bodies

• Predictive habitat mapping and vulnerability analysis for endangered or narrowly distributed flora and fauna

• Integration into regional biodiversity action plans and environmental impact assessments (EIAs)

• Establishing scalable baseline modeling frameworks for climate change adaptation studies in fragile ecosystems
KSCSTE.key_benefits_&_value_proposition:
• Demonstrates high predictive accuracy with an AUC ratio of 1.6 and robust validation metrics (Kappa, TSS)

• Expands potential conservation areas by locating highly suitable zones (2,393 km²) far exceeding the current restricted baseline (283 km²)

• Delivers actionable, field-verified telemetry data pinpointing ten concrete translocation sites across the southern Western Ghats

KSCSTE.technology_name: Anoxic-Oxic Sequential Batch Biofilm Reactor: Wastewater Treatment System
KSCSTE.institution: KSCSTE- Centre for Water Resources Development and Management (CWRDM)
KSCSTE.secondary_sector: Waste Management & Sanitation, Water Resource Management, Biotechnology & Life Sciences
KSCSTE.problem_solved: Conventional Sequencing Batch Reactors (SBRs) for treating high-strength slaughterhouse wastewater suffer from high sludge production and poor settling (high sludge volume index).
KSCSTE.description: This innovation is an Anoxic-Oxic Sequential Batch Biofilm Reactor (SBBR) that incorporates inert carrier materials into a conventional SBR system to support biofilm growth. This design combines suspended and attached growth systems to simultaneous remove carbonaceous organic matter and nutrients from high-strength slaughterhouse wastewater. Operating under phased oxygen conditions (aerobic/anoxic react combinations), the system optimizes microbial biomass accumulation and accelerates organic matter decomposition without excessive sludge production.
KSCSTE.applications_&_industry_standard:
• Treatment of high-BOD and nutrient-rich wastewater from commercial slaughterhouses and meat processing units

• Upgrading existing municipal or industrial wastewater treatment plants to biofilm-based systems

• Decentralized sanitation and effluent treatment in resource-limited or space-constrained settings

• Effluent compliance management for food and beverage industry processing facilities
KSCSTE.key_benefits_&_value_proposition:
• Achieves 92-94% COD removal rates for high initial concentrations up to 2800 mg/L

• Reaches maximum organic matter decomposition rapidly within a four-hour window

• Mitigates common operational drawbacks by lowering sludge volume index and minimizing overall sludge production

KSCSTE.technology_name: Smart Rainwater Sampling System: Automated Time-Integrated Sampler
KSCSTE.institution: KSCSTE- Centre for Water Resources Development and Management (CWRDM)
KSCSTE.secondary_sector: Water Resource Management, Climate & Hydrological Monitoring Tools
KSCSTE.problem_solved: Traditional rainwater sampling relies on daily or monthly composites, failing to capture short-term variations and risking cross-contamination between intervals.
KSCSTE.description: An automated, low-cost rainwater sampling system designed to capture the high-resolution spatial and temporal variability of rainfall. The system collects rainwater through a funnel and automatically pumps it into separate sample bottles at user-defined intervals (e.g., hourly). Constructed from inert materials to eliminate chemical contamination, the lightweight and weatherproof device features automatic shut-off when rainfall ceases, optimized energy efficiency for field applications, and remote monitoring compatibility.
KSCSTE.applications_&_industry_standard:
• High-resolution sequential data gathering for detailed hydrological modeling and climate studies

• Real-time monitoring of environmental pollution dynamics and acid rain trends by research agencies

• Scalable deployment in remote networks with limited existing infrastructure by environmental bodies

• Integration into agricultural planning systems requiring precise local precipitation records
KSCSTE.contact_person: Dr. U Surendran, Dr. Resmi T R & Dr. Naveena K
KSCSTE.key_benefits_&_value_proposition:
• Eliminates sample cross-contamination across collection intervals through inert construction materials

• Minimizes field power demands via an automatic shut-off capability when rainfall stops

• Enables high-resolution, user-defined interval configurations tailored for varied research scopes

KSCSTE.technology_name: Biochar from Bamboo Waste: Sustainable Carbon Sequestration Solution
KSCSTE.institution: KSCSTE- Kerala Forest Research Institute (KFRI)
KSCSTE.secondary_sector: Waste Management & Sanitation, Climate Action & Carbon Sequestration, Soil Health & Fertility
KSCSTE.problem_solved: Accumulation of unmanaged bamboo biomass waste alongside degraded soil health and the critical need for scalable carbon capture methods.
KSCSTE.description: A sustainable production framework established at KFRI's Field Research Centre in Palappilly that converts bamboo waste into biochar. This stable, carbon-rich material is created through the pyrolysis of biomass under oxygen-limited conditions. The resulting porous substance enhances soil structure, boosts microbial dynamics, and acts as a long-term terrestrial carbon sink that safely locks away carbon for hundreds to thousands of years.
KSCSTE.applications_&_industry_standard:
• Commercial production of organic soil amendments and soil fertility boosters

• Integration into waste-to-resource programs for agricultural or forestry residues

• Generation of high-permanence carbon removal credits for compliance and voluntary markets

• Implementation in large-scale land restoration and degraded site remediation projects
KSCSTE.contact_person: Dr. S Sandeep & Dr. Badole Shrikant Purushottam
KSCSTE.key_benefits_&_value_proposition:
• Implements a high-permanence carbon sink that stabilizes carbon in soil for hundreds of years

• Maximizes nutrient retention and water-holding capacity via an intensely porous structural profile

• Turns a regional biomass waste stream into a high-value resource for climate and agriculture

KSCSTE.technology_name: Coir Fibre Root Trainers: Biodegradable Plant Nursery Container
KSCSTE.institution: KSCSTE- Kerala Forest Research Institute (KFRI)
KSCSTE.secondary_sector: Forestry & Biodiversity , Waste Management & Sanitation
KSCSTE.problem_solved: Huge consumption of single-use plastic containers in forest nurseries causes massive plastic pollution, alongside issues like root coiling and transplant shock in traditional bags.
KSCSTE.description: India's first Coir Fibre-Based Root Trainers (CRT) are developed from latex-sprayed coir mattress material as a fully biodegradable, eco-friendly alternative to plastic bags. Designed with four internal ridges and a 20mm drainage hole, these 150 cc containers promote healthy root architecture and prevent harmful root coiling. The units can be planted directly into the earth alongside the seedling, decomposing naturally over time.
KSCSTE.applications_&_industry_standard:
• Mass adoption by state forest departments and municipal nurseries to meet plastic bans

• Commercial manufacturing by coir cooperatives and rural self-help groups

• Retail distribution in commercial horticulture, landscaping, and consumer home-gardening sectors

• Export market positioning as premium eco-friendly agricultural planting materials
KSCSTE.contact_person: Dr. Sujanapal P & Mr. S Sheik Hyder Hussain, IFS (Rtd)
KSCSTE.key_benefits_&_value_proposition:
• Eliminates single-use plastics entirely from forest and commercial nursery operations

• Permits direct planting to minimize transplant shock and field root damage

• Promotes local employment and adds economic value to agricultural coconut husk waste streams

KSCSTE.technology_name: Killimangalam Kora Grass Mats: Traditional Woven Craft
KSCSTE.institution: KSCSTE- Kerala Forest Research Institute (KFRI)
KSCSTE.secondary_sector: Consumer Goods & Crafts, Rural Livelihoods & Skill Development
KSCSTE.problem_solved: Protecting traditional knowledge and boosting market visibility for an eco-friendly artisan craft through Geographical Indication.
KSCSTE.description: Killimangalam Kora Grass Mats are a traditional craft woven using fine-count kora grass (Cyperus spp.) in the Thrissur and Palakkad districts. Traditionally practiced by the Kurava community, the craft involves the intricate weaving of coarse and fine mats using high-twist warp threads. Designs are culturally inspired, featuring palm leaves, elephants, and traditional attire. Recognized for their aesthetic value and eco-friendliness, the mats earned the UNESCO Seal of Excellence in 2004. KFRI has initiated the process to secure a Geographical Indication (GI) tag to protect this heritage and support weavers.
KSCSTE.applications_&_industry_standard:
• Commercial retail of eco-friendly sleeping mats, yoga mats, carpets, and wall hangings

• Cultural tourism and export of premium traditional Indian handicrafts

• Empowerment and income generation for the rural Kurava artisan community

• Geographical Indication (GI) branding for authentic textile and home decor markets
KSCSTE.key_benefits_&_value_proposition:
• Provides fully eco-friendly and functional consumer products like yoga mats and carpets

• Preserves culturally significant indigenous creativity and traditional knowledge

• Secured the UNESCO CCI Seal of Excellence for outstanding craftsmanship

• Empowers local artisan communities through increased market visibility via GI tag pursuit

KSCSTE.technology_name: Organo Clay from Waste Mica: Sustainable Pollution Control Material
KSCSTE.institution: KSCSTE- Kerala Forest Research Institute (KFRI)
KSCSTE.secondary_sector: Pollution Control & Environmental Remediation, Waste Management & Sanitation, Soil Health & Fertility
KSCSTE.problem_solved: Rising environmental contamination from heavy metals, dyes, and organic pollutants requires low-cost, eco-friendly remediation technologies.
KSCSTE.description: Organo clay synthesized from waste mica and humic acid offers a sustainable solution for environmental pollution control. By functionalizing raw industrial mica waste with humic acid, the material's sorptive properties are significantly enhanced, enabling efficient removal of heavy metals, dyes, and organic pollutants. The mild, cost-effective synthesis process avoids hazardous chemicals. The resulting composite exhibits strong chelation and ion exchange properties, featuring a dual hydrophilic-hydrophobic character. It demonstrates excellent long-term structural stability and regeneration capabilities, allowing for multiple reuse cycles without significant performance loss.
KSCSTE.applications_&_industry_standard:
• Wastewater treatment and purification for industrial and municipal effluent facilities

• Eco-friendly soil remediation of contaminated agricultural or brownfield sites

• Commercial manufacturing of low-cost environmental filtration materials

• Waste-to-resource valorization within the industrial mica mining sector
KSCSTE.contact_person: Ms. Navya M & Dr. S Sandeep
KSCSTE.key_benefits_&_value_proposition:
• Upcycles industrial waste mica into a highly valuable environmental remediation material

• Efficiently removes mixed contaminants via complexation, electrostatic attraction, and π-π interactions

• Enables multiple reuse cycles through good regeneration capability without significant performance loss

• Avoids hazardous chemicals during synthesis, making it safe and cost-effective for large-scale use

KSCSTE.technology_name: Nanocomposite Beads for Efficient Nitrate Removal: Ternary Nanocomposite Technology
KSCSTE.institution: KSCSTE- Centre for Water Resources Development and Management (CWRDM)
KSCSTE.secondary_sector: Water Resource Management, Waste Management & Sanitation
KSCSTE.problem_solved: Nitrate contamination in drinking water exceeding the safe permissible limit of 10 mg/L, causing serious health risks.
KSCSTE.description: A cost-effective, sustainable ternary nanocomposite technology using Fe₃O₄@chitosan beads coated with Ag-doped TiO₂. The system combines the high adsorption capacity of magnetite (Fe₃O₄), the binding and biodegradable matrix of chitosan, and the advanced photocatalytic action of titanium dioxide (TiO₂). Silver (Ag) doping enhances the composite's visible light activity, enabling efficient solar-powered nitrate reduction via co-precipitation and sol-gel synthesis crosslinked with glutaraldehyde.
KSCSTE.applications_&_industry_standard:
• Point-of-use (POU) domestic water purification systems and consumer filters

• Decentralized groundwater remediation schemes in high-fertilizer agricultural zones

• Large-scale industrial effluent treatment setups for nitrate-heavy manufacturing discharges

• Commercial production of functionalized photocatalytic water treatment media
KSCSTE.key_benefits_&_value_proposition:
• Achieves ~97% total nitrate removal within one hour of direct sunlight exposure

• Provides rapid ~66% initial removal within 30 minutes via surface adsorption kinetics

• Outperforms pure chitosan beads due to enhanced electrostatic attraction and photocatalytic properties

• Already validated via a functional prototype water filter tested on real groundwater samples

KSCSTE.technology_name: Rainfall Insights Dashboard: HYDRAH Data Visualization Tool
KSCSTE.institution: KSCSTE- Centre for Water Resources Development and Management (CWRDM)
KSCSTE.secondary_sector: Climate & Hydrological Monitoring Tools, Water Resource Management
KSCSTE.problem_solved: Lack of accessible, interactive tools to explore and analyze rainfall trends, patterns, and extreme events in tropical regions.
KSCSTE.description: The HYDRAH (Hydrological Rainfall Analysis for Humid Tropics) dashboard is an interactive data visualization tool developed using the Shiny package in R. It enables the exploration of rainfall data to analyze long-term trends, anomalies, and extreme events in humid tropical regions. The intuitive interface features dedicated tabs for rainfall overviews, seasonal analysis using time series plots and histograms, and a statistical summary that identifies extreme precipitation. Designed for researchers and planners, the platform supports flood risk assessment, water resource management, and climate resilience strategies through data-driven insights.
KSCSTE.applications_&_industry_standard:
• Integration into government flood risk assessment and climate resilience planning frameworks

• Deployment by environmental agencies for high-level hydrological research and monitoring

• Water resource management and infrastructure planning by municipal authorities

• Academic and scientific analysis of extreme precipitation events and seasonal shifts
KSCSTE.key_benefits_&_value_proposition:
• Provides intuitive visualization of annual, monthly, and daily rainfall distributions

• Detects intra-annual shifts in precipitation behavior through deep seasonal analysis tools

• Identifies extreme rainfall events to actively support flood risk assessments

• Offers flexible data manipulation with user-friendly date range and seasonal filters

KSCSTE.technology_name: ML-Based Rainfall Nowcasting: Short-Term Precipitation Forecasting System
KSCSTE.institution: KSCSTE-Institute for Climate Change Studies
KSCSTE.secondary_sector: AI/ML & Data Analytics, Climate & Hydrological Monitoring Tools, GIS & Geospatial Systems
KSCSTE.technology_type: AI/ML Model or Algorithm, Software/Digital Platform
KSCSTE.problem_solved: Lack of high-resolution, short-term rainfall predictions that account for complex spatial and temporal patterns across diverse local terrains.
KSCSTE.description: An experimental machine learning-based forecasting tool that provides high-resolution, short-term rainfall predictions. The system utilizes real-time infrared and water vapor data from geostationary satellites alongside a high-resolution Digital Elevation Model (DEM) to account for local terrain influences like elevation and slope. The data is processed through a Convolutional Long Short-Term Memory (ConvLSTM) deep learning architecture designed to recognize complex spatiotemporal patterns. The model outputs dynamic rainfall intensity maps (mm/hr) that update continuously as new satellite data is received.
KSCSTE.applications_&_industry_standard:
• Disaster preparedness and early warning systems by emergency management agencies

• Short-term agricultural planning and active crop protection

• Water resource management and municipal reservoir operations

• Integration into commercial weather forecasting and meteorological platforms
KSCSTE.contact_person: Dr. Sinan Nizar & Dr. C. C. Bajish
KSCSTE.key_benefits_&_value_proposition:
• Provides high-resolution, short-term predictions of rainfall dynamically updating in mm/hr

• Accounts for local terrain influence on weather systems using a high-resolution DEM

• Recognizes complex spatial and temporal atmospheric patterns via ConvLSTM deep learning architecture

KSCSTE.technology_name: Copper-Nickel Nanocomposite: Bimetallic Water Purification Material
KSCSTE.institution: KSCSTE- Centre for Water Resources Development and Management (CWRDM)
KSCSTE.secondary_sector: Water Resource Management, Waste Management & Sanitation
KSCSTE.problem_solved: Arsenic, heavy metal, and bacterial contamination in water requiring stable, scalable, and reusable purification methods.
KSCSTE.description: A water purification technology utilizing bimetallic copper-nickel nanoparticles (CuNi BNPs) embedded within porous styrene-divinylbenzene (St-DVB) polymer microbeads. Copper provides low toxicity and antimicrobial properties, while nickel offers strong chemical and magnetic characteristics. Combining them enhances heavy metal and bacterial removal, particularly for arsenic adsorption. Immobilizing the nanoparticles on reusable polymer microbeads prevents aggregation and increases the active surface area. The resulting nanocomposite operates efficiently in continuous adsorption column systems, providing a stable, low-cost, and scalable method for water treatment across a wide pH range.
KSCSTE.applications_&_industry_standard:
• Heavy metal and arsenic removal in municipal water treatment facilities

• Continuous adsorption column systems for industrial effluent purification

• Point-of-use domestic water filtration devices for rural and urban settings

• Commercial production of reusable, porous polymer adsorbent microbeads
KSCSTE.contact_person: Dr. P S Harikumar & Ms. Hridya T K
KSCSTE.key_benefits_&_value_proposition:
• Provides high efficacy in adsorbing arsenic and bacterial contaminants from water

• Prevents nanoparticle aggregation and enables easy separation via immobilization on polymer microbeads

• Functions effectively across a wide pH range with low leakage and long-term usability

• Reduces production costs by using abundant raw materials and reusable polymer supports

KSCSTE.technology_name: Microbial Consortium for Composting: High-Altitude Biowaste Management
KSCSTE.institution: Integrated Rural Technology centre (IRTC)
KSCSTE.secondary_sector: Waste Management & Sanitation, Rural Livelihoods & Skill Development, Soil Health & Fertility
KSCSTE.technology_type: Biological Resource (Strain/Enzyme/Vaccine/Biopesticide), Process/Method (Research Study or Evaluation)
KSCSTE.problem_solved: Conventional biowaste composting methods fail to function effectively in high-altitude, low-temperature climatic conditions.
KSCSTE.description: A customized microbial consortium developed to enable effective biowaste management in high-altitude, low-temperature regions like Munnar. The system isolates local psychrophilic (cold-tolerant) and efficient microorganisms from local soil and decayed debris to ensure optimal functioning in challenging climates. This biological framework is complemented by a polyhouse structure designed to trap solar heat and maintain favorable daytime composting temperatures. The consortium currently processes 3-4 tons of biowaste daily into an organic fertilizer marketed as "Munnar Green Biomanure."
KSCSTE.applications_&_industry_standard:
• Municipal biowaste management and sanitation in high-altitude or low-temperature regions

• Commercial production and retail of organic fertilizers and biomanure

• Implementation in eco-tourism zones requiring sustainable, sustainable waste treatment

• Rural livelihood and women's empowerment programs via local manufacturing cooperatives
KSCSTE.key_benefits_&_value_proposition:
• Enables continuous daily windrow composting of 3-4 tons of biowaste in low-temperature environments

• Relies on localized, cold-tolerant psychrophilic microbes rather than generic composting strains

• Generates direct local employment and supports women's empowerment in rural communities

• Safely mitigates environmental and public health hazards from unmanaged waste

KSCSTE.technology_name: Microbial Consortia for Sustainable Waste Management: Tropical Waste Processing Blend
KSCSTE.institution: Integrated Rural Technology centre (IRTC)
KSCSTE.secondary_sector: Rural Livelihoods & Skill Development, Waste Management & Sanitation
KSCSTE.problem_solved: Environmental hazards from waste mismanagement requiring scalable, eco-friendly, and decentralized biological waste processing alternatives.
KSCSTE.description: An eco-friendly waste management solution utilizing purpose-driven microbial consortia developed for tropical regions. The technology relies on the large-scale production of tailored microbial blends optimized to treat diverse waste streams via microbial fermentation. Supported by a dedicated repository for consistent inoculant supply, these adaptable blends enable year-round, decentralized zero-waste processing. The initiative replaces conventional chemical treatments with green biotechnology, promoting a circular economy where biowaste is safely converted into resources.
KSCSTE.applications_&_industry_standard:
• Decentralized solid waste management by local municipal bodies and households

• Commercial production and distribution of microbial inoculant blends

• Integration into corporate zero-waste disposal practices and industrial waste treatment

• Generation of rural livelihoods and bio-based enterprise cooperatives for women
KSCSTE.key_benefits_&_value_proposition:
• Enables scalable, year-round decentralized waste processing without relying on chemical treatments

• Minimizes environmental hazards and public health risks associated with waste mismanagement

• Supports a circular economy by safely converting diverse waste streams into usable resources

• Creates direct livelihood opportunities and drives women's participation in bio-based enterprises

KSCSTE.technology_name: Rooftop Rainwater Calculator: Web-Based Harvesting Estimation Tool
KSCSTE.institution: KSCSTE- Centre for Water Resources Development and Management (CWRDM)
KSCSTE.secondary_sector: Water Resource Management, Climate & Hydrological Monitoring Tools
KSCSTE.problem_solved: Lack of localized, scientific planning tools for household-level rooftop rainwater harvesting systems and storage capacity estimation.
KSCSTE.description: A user-centric, web-based digital tool designed to promote household-level water security through the scientific planning of rooftop rainwater harvesting (RWH). Developed specifically for Kerala's climate, the system integrates location-based meteorological data with user inputs such as rooftop dimensions, roof material, and household size. It estimates the harvestable water volume across key hydrological seasons and calculates the optimal storage capacity required during periods of water scarcity. Additionally, it provides preliminary guidance on implementing physical RWH components like gutters, filters, and recharge structures.
KSCSTE.applications_&_industry_standard:
• Household-level deployment for decentralized domestic water security planning

• Integration into municipal water conservation and urban planning frameworks

• Support for environmental NGOs and policymakers promoting climate adaptation

• Lead-generation and system sizing for commercial rainwater harvesting equipment vendors
KSCSTE.contact_person: Mr. Prajith V., Ms. Shafna K P, Mr. Prasanth S S
KSCSTE.key_benefits_&_value_proposition:
• Accurately estimates harvestable rainwater based on localized climate and household parameters

• Calculates the optimal storage capacity needed to bridge seasonal water shortages

• Provides actionable implementation guidance for essential RWH components

• Fosters resource conservation and empowers communities toward self-reliant water management

KSCSTE.technology_name: Nature-Inspired Neurotoxins from Nepenthes: Insecticidal and Therapeutic Compounds
KSCSTE.institution: KSCSTE- Jawaharlal Nehru Tropical Botanic Garden & Research Institute (JNTBGRI)
KSCSTE.secondary_sector: Forestry & Biodiversity , Pharmaceuticals & Nutraceuticals, Crop Protection & Disease Management
KSCSTE.problem_solved: Need for natural, plant-based acetylcholinesterase (AChE) inhibitors for safe agricultural pest control and Alzheimer's disease therapeutics.
KSCSTE.description: Indian Nepenthes pitcher plants act as natural CO₂ chambers, secreting an extrafloral nectar (EFN) laced with (+)-isoshinanolone, a natural inhibitor of acetylcholinesterase (AChE). This neurotoxic compound acts as a 'toxic sugar bait' that impairs neuronal activity and flight response in insects. This discovery reveals the plant's deceptive prey capture strategy and identifies a potent dual-use molecule. The extracted AChE inhibitor presents strong translational potential as both a safe, natural insecticide for agriculture and a promising candidate molecule for Alzheimer's disease therapy, blending ecology with pharmacology.
KSCSTE.applications_&_industry_standard:
• Commercial development of natural, bio-based insecticides for agricultural pest management

• Pharmaceutical research and drug development for Alzheimer's disease therapies

• Biomimicry and chemical synthesis of (+)-isoshinanolone for commercial applications

• Biodiversity conservation and chemical profiling of endemic carnivorous plants
KSCSTE.key_benefits_&_value_proposition:
• Provides a natural, plant-derived inhibitor of acetylcholinesterase (AChE)

• Acts as a highly effective natural insecticide by impairing insect neuronal activity and flight response

• Offers a promising candidate molecule for the development of Alzheimer's disease therapeutics

KSCSTE.technology_name: Nutritious Bamboo-based Food Products: Shoot Powder and Flakes
KSCSTE.institution: KSCSTE- Kerala Forest Research Institute (KFRI)
KSCSTE.secondary_sector: Food Processing & Value Addition, Pharmaceuticals & Nutraceuticals, Rural Livelihoods & Skill Development
KSCSTE.problem_solved: High perishability, short harvest windows, and cyanogenic toxicity of fresh bamboo shoots limit their culinary adoption and commercial utilization.
KSCSTE.description: Standardized processing protocols to convert fresh, highly perishable bamboo shoots into shelf-stable, safe, and nutrient-dense food products: bamboo shoot powder and freeze-dried flakes. The process removes naturally occurring cyanogenic compounds to ensure safety. The powder can be blended into traditional staple recipes (breads, biscuits), while the freeze-dried flakes leverage lyophilization technology (sublimation under vacuum) to preserve original flavor, texture, and nutritional integrity while significantly extending shelf life.
KSCSTE.applications_&_industry_standard:
• Commercial food processing and manufacturing (bakery, snacks, functional foods)

• Production of shelf-stable health supplements and high-fiber nutritional additives

• Rural entrepreneurship and local value-addition setups near bamboo harvesting clusters

• Supply chain sourcing for modern culinary and packaged food industries
KSCSTE.key_benefits_&_value_proposition:
• Eliminates raw shoot perishability issues by transforming them into highly stable commercial ingredients

• Standardized protocols effectively neutralize dangerous cyanogenic compounds for guaranteed food safety

• Lyophilization technology preserves maximum original micronutrients, active fibers, texture, and flavor profile

• Creates viable rural enterprise models and value-addition opportunities at the agricultural source

KSCSTE.technology_name: Sustainable & High-Potency Dried Mushrooms Powder for the Future
KSCSTE.institution: Integrated Rural Technology centre (IRTC)
KSCSTE.secondary_sector: Food Processing & Value Addition, Rural Livelihoods & Skill Development
KSCSTE.problem_solved: Short fresh market windows, high contamination risk, and technical barriers in rural mushroom cultivation that limit enterprise scalability and grower income.
KSCSTE.description: An end-to-end scientific mushroom cultivation and value-addition model that combines agricultural biotechnology with decentralized production systems. The technology features the production of certified, high-purity, contamination-free spawn and pre-sterilized, inoculated "ready-to-fruit" mushroom beds that reduce setup complexity for growers. The model incorporates standardized post-harvest dehydration and powdering techniques designed to eliminate perishability while retaining peak flavor, texture, and nutritional profiles.
KSCSTE.applications_&_industry_standard:
• Commercial manufacturing of high-protein, functional mushroom powders and dried foods

• Distribution networks for pre-sterilized, ready-to-fruit domestic and commercial growing kits

• B2B supply of certified, genetically pure mushroom spawn to large-scale cultivation operations

• Sourcing of natural savory flavor-enhancers and micronutrient additives for the FMCG food sector
KSCSTE.key_benefits_&_value_proposition:
• Converts highly perishable fresh harvests into long-shelf-life, high-value commercial commodities

• Ready-to-fruit inoculated beds drastically reduce operational labor, specialized setup costs, and contamination risks

• Validated at scale through an active ecosystem supporting over 400 farmers and 1,000 trained individuals

• Integrates grassroots rural entrepreneurship with standardized quality-control biotechnology

KSCSTE.technology_name: Probiotic Chocolate with Prebiotic Fibres from Kerala's Seasonal Fruits
KSCSTE.institution: KSCSTE- Centre of Excellence in Microbiome (CoEM)
KSCSTE.secondary_sector: Food Processing & Value Addition, Rural Livelihoods & Skill Development, Pharmaceuticals & Nutraceuticals
KSCSTE.problem_solved: Underutilization of seasonal regional fruits leading to high food waste, combined with a lack of indulgent, clean-label functional food options that support preventive gut health.
KSCSTE.description: A functional food product incorporating live probiotic cultures inside a premium chocolate base enriched with natural prebiotic fibers. The fibers are derived from underutilized, seasonal indigenous fruits of Kerala, including jackfruit, Indian apple, banana, mango, and pineapple. This formulation delivers active gut-microbiome support along with naturally occurring dietary fibers, antioxidants, and essential micronutrients. The clean-label processing model focuses on high-value post-harvest resource utilization to deliver a healthy wellness snack.
KSCSTE.applications_&_industry_standard:
• Premium wellness confectionery manufacturing and retail packaging

• Industrial scale extraction of prebiotic fibers from indigenous tropical fruits

• Strategic sourcing networks with agricultural cooperatives for seasonal fruit processing

• E-commerce and boutique retail distribution targeting the functional health food market
KSCSTE.contact_person: Dr. Mahesh S Krishna & Dr. Sabu Thomas
KSCSTE.key_benefits_&_value_proposition:
• Delivers a synergistic combination of live probiotics and natural prebiotic fibers in an indulgent format

• Maximizes post-harvest utilization of highly perishable local fruits to significantly decrease seasonal agricultural waste

• Enriches the confectionery medium with natural antioxidants and essential micronutrients without chemical additives

• Provides a highly marketable entry into premium, clean-label health and wellness segments

KSCSTE.technology_name: Next-Generation Starter Culture for Kerala's Traditional Fermented Food
KSCSTE.institution: KSCSTE- Centre of Excellence in Microbiome (CoEM)
KSCSTE.secondary_sector: Food Processing & Value Addition, Biotechnology & Life Sciences, Rural Livelihoods & Skill Development
KSCSTE.problem_solved: Variations in culinary quality, unpredictable results, and elevated risks of microbial contamination associated with traditional back-slop fermentation practices.
KSCSTE.description: A reliable, standardized, and ready-to-use modular microbial starter culture blend derived from authentic traditional idli and dosa batters. The formulation relies on isolated beneficial bacteria chosen for optimized acidification, active gas production, and distinct textural properties. Strains are validated via advanced genome sequencing to ensure performance, absolute safety, and potential probiotic value, offering a clean-label alternative free from synthetic additives or preservatives.
KSCSTE.applications_&_industry_standard:
• Commercial production of packaged starter cultures for household and industrial culinary spaces

• Formulation of clean-label, functional probiotic foods and health supplements

• Standardized supply chains for commercial batter manufacturers and corporate food brands

• Grassroots micro-enterprise and rural development models based on bio-input distribution
KSCSTE.contact_person: Dr. Aparna Shankar & Dr. Sabu Thomas
KSCSTE.key_benefits_&_value_proposition:
• Delivers consistent, predictable, and highly uniform fermentation quality across batches

• Significantly minimizes dangerous microbial contamination risks inherent in wild back-sloping methods

• Formulated entirely without synthetic additives or preservatives, meeting clean-label standards

• Supports compliance with modern food safety trends and emerging regulatory restrictions on antibiotics

KSCSTE.technology_name: Fungus-Derived Antimicrobial for Pharma and Agri Use: Diethyl Phthalate Extraction
KSCSTE.institution: KSCSTE- Malabar Botanical Garden & Institute for Plant Sciences (MBGIPS)
KSCSTE.secondary_sector: Pharmaceuticals & Nutraceuticals, Crop Protection & Disease Management
KSCSTE.problem_solved: The global threat of antimicrobial resistance (AMR) creating an urgent need for novel, bio-based, broad-spectrum therapeutic and agricultural agents.
KSCSTE.description: A natural product-based innovation centered on the discovery of Diaporthe penetriteum, an endophytic fungus isolated from Lagenandra toxicaria that serves as a novel microbial source of diethyl phthalate. The fungus is cultured under controlled laboratory conditions, and its bioactive metabolites are extracted using an eco-friendly ethyl acetate process. High-Performance Liquid Chromatography (HPLC) analysis confirmed diethyl phthalate as the active compound, marking its first reported extraction from this species. The extract demonstrates strong broad-spectrum antimicrobial efficacy against major human pathogens, including Staphylococcus aureus, Bacillus subtilis, Pseudomonas aeruginosa, and E. coli.
KSCSTE.applications_&_industry_standard:
• Next-generation natural antibiotic formulations for human and animal healthcare

• Bio-based crop protectants and biopesticides for sustainable agricultural pest control

• Out-licensing pipelines for pharmaceutical companies targeting multi-drug resistant strains

• Commercialization of green, eco-friendly microbial metabolite extraction processes
KSCSTE.key_benefits_&_value_proposition:
• Demonstrates high potency with zones of inhibition ranging from 20.5 mm to 23.7 mm against major pathogens

• Employs a green, low-toxicity processing methodology utilizing eco-friendly ethyl acetate extraction

• Offers dual-use versatility with massive market potential across both pharmaceutical and agritech sectors

• Directly addresses international and national clinical priority frameworks for AMR mitigation

KSCSTE.technology_name: Gene-to-Structure Platform for Rapid Antiviral Discovery
KSCSTE.institution: Institute of Advanced Virology (IAV)
KSCSTE.secondary_sector: Pharmaceuticals & Nutraceuticals, Genetic & Molecular Research Tools
KSCSTE.problem_solved: Long timelines, high technical fragmentation, and execution complexity in resolving viral protein structures for structure-based drug design.
KSCSTE.description: An end-to-end operational platform established by the Department of Antiviral Research (DAV) to support biotech startups and pharmaceutical partners in accelerating antiviral therapeutics. The platform provides comprehensive structural characterization of viral and host proteins by integrating target gene cloning, recombinant protein expression across bacterial, insect, and mammalian systems, and high-purity protein purification. 3D structures are determined via X-ray crystallography to enable molecular docking, complemented by real-time binding assays using Bio-Layer Interferometry (BLI) and Isothermal Titration Calorimetry (ITC) to measure exact drug-target interactions.
KSCSTE.applications_&_industry_standard:
• Contract research and development (CRD) services for emerging biotech teams

• Structure-based drug design (SBDD) and computer-aided molecular docking validation

• Early-stage viral target discovery and later-stage therapeutic lead optimization pipelines

• Strategic co-development of next-generation broad-spectrum antiviral therapeutics
KSCSTE.key_benefits_&_value_proposition:
• Significantly compresses the timeline from target gene isolation to final 3D protein structure resolution

• Provides fully integrated capabilities from molecular cloning to precise biophysical interaction mechanics (BLI/ITC)

• Delivers high-resolution structural blueprints crucial for targeted, data-informed lead optimization

• Features flexible, modular collaboration structures optimized for startup incubation and industrial alignment

KSCSTE.technology_name: Point-of-Care Prognostic Device for Dengue Severity
KSCSTE.institution: KSCSTE- Kerala Forest Research Institute (KFRI)
KSCSTE.secondary_sector: Biotechnology & Life Sciences, AI/ML & Data Analytics
KSCSTE.problem_solved: Absence of reliable early-stage prognostic tools to predict severe dengue progression, causing massive clinical uncertainty and high rates of unnecessary hospitalizations.
KSCSTE.description: A lateral flow-based point-of-use prognostic device driven by machine learning insights to predict dengue severity early in the febrile phase. Instead of detecting viral antigens or antibodies to confirm infection, this device identifies and quantifies specific endothelial-derived host proteins discovered via machine learning algorithms to be differentially expressed in patients tracking toward severe complications (e.g., plasma leakage, organ dysfunction). This portable strip format tests serum or plasma samples at the frontline to enable early risk stratification before visible clinical deterioration occurs.
KSCSTE.applications_&_industry_standard:
• Frontline clinical diagnostics in primary health centers and outbreak zones

• Manufacturing of rapid lateral flow prognostic test strips and reader devices

• Strategic supply chains for emergency medical services and resource-limited clinics

• Integration into digital healthcare triage systems and telemedicine diagnostic networks
KSCSTE.key_benefits_&_value_proposition:
• Shifts dengue clinical management from late-stage reactive treatment to proactive early risk stratification

• Operates as a rapid, affordable, and portable strip device ideal for resource-limited and rural settings

• Reduces severe clinical strain on healthcare infrastructure by preventing unnecessary hospital admissions

• Utilizes highly specific host-derived endothelial biomarkers validated through pilot machine learning models

KSCSTE.technology_name: Pathogen Enrichment Method for Accurate Microbiome Sequencing
KSCSTE.institution: Institute of Advanced Virology (IAV)
KSCSTE.secondary_sector: Genetic & Molecular Research Tools, Pharmaceuticals & Nutraceuticals
KSCSTE.problem_solved: Overwhelming presence of host DNA masks microbial genetic signatures in metagenomic sequencing, lowering diagnostic sensitivity for low-abundance pathogens and increasing sequencing costs.
KSCSTE.description: A novel selective host-genome depletion and pathogen read enrichment method optimized for high-resolution metagenomic sequencing of gut and organ microbiomes (covering bacteria, phages, and viruses). The protocol decreases the ratio of background host genetic material before sequencing, allowing low-abundance pathogens to be detected with higher sensitivity. The method is designed to track microbiome shifts across healthy, diseased, chronic treatment, or altered dietary states without requiring altered sequencing hardware.
KSCSTE.applications_&_industry_standard:
• Clinical molecular diagnostics for complex or low-load viral and bacterial infections

• Commercial metagenomic sequencing preparation kits and reagent manufacturing

• Contract research services for validating nutraceutical and dietary microbiome shifts

• High-throughput public health surveillance and infectious disease epidemiology
KSCSTE.key_benefits_&_value_proposition:
• Maximizes sequencing efficiency by selectively reducing masking host background reads

• Enhances high-confidence detection limits for rare or low-abundance pathogens and phages

• Reduces overall raw sequencing data requirements, lowering cost per sample and increasing throughput

• Compatible across diverse specimen matrices for clinical tracking, dietetics, and therapeutics

KSCSTE.technology_name: Monoclonal Antibodies for Detecting and Blocking Viral Infections
KSCSTE.institution: Institute of Advanced Virology (IAV)
KSCSTE.secondary_sector: Genetic & Molecular Research Tools, Pharmaceuticals & Nutraceuticals
KSCSTE.problem_solved: Lack of highly specific diagnostic tools and targeted therapeutics to rapidly detect and neutralize emerging and re-emerging viral threats.
KSCSTE.description: A pipeline for developing monoclonal antibodies (mAbs) using hybridoma technology. BALB/c mice are immunized with viral structural proteins via plasmid-based gene delivery. Upon optimal IgG response, splenocytes are fused with myeloma cells, selected via HAT medium, and subcloned to establish stable monoclones. The mAbs undergo functional characterization (Western blot, immunofluorescence) and epitope mapping to pinpoint critical antigenic sites, establishing a foundation for neutralizing therapeutic antibodies and advanced diagnostic assays.
KSCSTE.applications_&_industry_standard:
• Commercial manufacturing of rapid viral diagnostic kits and ELISA reagents

• Therapeutic monoclonal antibody design for neutralizing viral infections

• National biodefense stockpiling and outbreak surveillance programs

• Commercial out-licensing to global pharmaceutical and clinical diagnostic companies
KSCSTE.key_benefits_&_value_proposition:
• Provides exceptionally high specificity in detecting viral antigens for precise diagnostics

• Establishes stable monoclones capable of long-term, consistent antibody secretion

• Pinpoints critical antigenic sites to design therapeutics that block viral entry mechanisms

• Lays a scalable groundwork for rapid response against emerging national infectious disease threats

KSCSTE.technology_name: Rapid Point-of-Care Diagnostics for Viral Infections: Lateral Flow & RT-LAMP Assays
KSCSTE.institution: Institute of Advanced Virology (IAV)
KSCSTE.secondary_sector: Genetic & Molecular Research Tools, Biotechnology & Life Sciences
KSCSTE.problem_solved: Lack of timely, accessible, and cost-effective diagnostics for acute viral infections in outbreak-prone regions with limited centralized lab infrastructure.
KSCSTE.description: A next-generation diagnostic platform integrating antigen-antibody detection via lateral flow assays and nucleic acid detection using isothermal reverse transcription loop-mediated amplification (RT-LAMP). The lateral flow devices provide visual viral protein detection within minutes. The cartridge-based RT-LAMP enables rapid viral genetic amplification at a constant temperature, eliminating the need for complex thermocyclers. Both formats deliver results in 15-30 minutes and require minimal training, making them optimized for field and frontline deployment.
KSCSTE.applications_&_industry_standard:
• Frontline diagnostics in community clinics and mobile health units

• Field surveillance and rapid epidemic response by public health agencies

• Commercial manufacturing of rapid lateral flow strips and RT-LAMP diagnostic cartridges

• Stockpiling for pandemic preparedness in low-resource and high-risk regions
KSCSTE.key_benefits_&_value_proposition:
• Generates accurate diagnostic results within 15-30 minutes to support early clinical decision-making

• Eliminates the need for expensive thermocyclers by utilizing constant-temperature RT-LAMP amplification

• Operates with extreme simplicity, requiring minimal training and no specialized lab equipment

• Provides a scalable, cost-effective solution to bridge diagnostic gaps in resource-limited settings

KSCSTE.technology_name: Recombinant Viral Antigens for Diagnostics and Vaccines
KSCSTE.institution: Institute of Advanced Virology (IAV)
KSCSTE.secondary_sector: Pharmaceuticals & Nutraceuticals, Genetic & Molecular Research Tools
KSCSTE.problem_solved: Limitations in scalability, safety, and structural/functional fidelity when producing highly specific viral proteins using traditional native antigen isolation methods.
KSCSTE.description: A robust protein expression platform using recombinant DNA technology to synthesize highly specific, safe, and scalable viral antigens. The platform features established optimization protocols and proprietary expression vectors tailored for two distinct pipelines: a fast, cost-effective E. coli bacterial system for rapid scalability, and a mammalian HEK293 cell platform capable of executing complex post-translational modifications, correct folding, and disulfide bond formations. Downstream processing is supported by automated ÄKTA pure™ chromatography systems for high-yield, high-purity isolation.
KSCSTE.applications_&_industry_standard:
• Production of raw antigenic proteins for commercial diagnostic kit manufacturing (ELISA, Lateral Flow)

• Development of subunit vaccine candidates and clinical therapeutic proteins

• Contract research services for structural biology and target validation programs

• Standardized supply chains for academic, industrial, and clinical research reagents
KSCSTE.key_benefits_&_value_proposition:
• Offers target-specific vector customization maximizing upstream yields for varied host types

• Retains critical biological activity through authentic mammalian post-translational processing

• Utilizes advanced industrial chromatographic purification to secure exceptional protein purity levels

• Scalable infrastructure structured for seamless transition from lab-scale cloning to production runs

KSCSTE.technology_name: Affordable Advanced Wound Care Using Herbal-Based Nanopad
KSCSTE.institution: KSCSTE- Jawaharlal Nehru Tropical Botanic Garden & Research Institute (JNTBGRI)
KSCSTE.secondary_sector: Biotechnology & Life Sciences, Pharmaceuticals & Nutraceuticals
KSCSTE.problem_solved: High cost of advanced wound care products and the need for comprehensive multi-stage therapeutic intervention to accelerate delayed healing and prevent infections.
KSCSTE.description: A multi-functional nanofibre wound healing pad developed using a layer-by-layer construction strategy, where each layer executes a targeted therapeutic function. The core layer incorporates "Coded Compound X", a bioactive molecule isolated from "Coded Plant Y" via activity-guided isolation. Preclinical evaluations in rat models demonstrated superior wound repair metrics compared to standard reference drugs. The multi-layered design acts synergistically to provide antimicrobial protection, optimal moisture retention, and accelerated tissue regeneration.
KSCSTE.applications_&_industry_standard:
• Advanced clinical wound dressings for chronic ulcers and burn management

• Mass-market first-aid, surgical, and emergency trauma care kits

• Manufacturing of specialized herbal-bioactive medical textiles

• Indigenous low-cost supply chains for rural and resource-limited healthcare sectors
KSCSTE.key_benefits_&_value_proposition:
• Employs a layer-by-layer architecture that handles multiple physiological stages of wound recovery simultaneously

• Validated through preclinical trials displaying enhanced healing rates over standard reference pharmaceuticals

• Provides a highly affordable, indigenous alternative to expensive imported advanced wound care dressings

• Synthesizes antimicrobial defense, moisture balancing, and tissue regeneration within a single lightweight pad

KSCSTE.technology_name: Safe & Scalable Sweet Flag Clones for Pharma Use: In Vitro Acorus calamus
KSCSTE.institution: KSCSTE- Jawaharlal Nehru Tropical Botanic Garden & Research Institute (JNTBGRI)
KSCSTE.secondary_sector: Forestry & Biodiversity , Pharmaceuticals & Nutraceuticals
KSCSTE.problem_solved: High toxicity and carcinogenic risks associated with elevated ß-asarone levels in natural sweet flag (Acorus calamus) varieties, which restricts their safe commercial and pharmaceutical use.
KSCSTE.description: Identification of elite, low ß-asarone accessions of Acorus calamus (sweet flag) and the development of rapid in vitro multiplication protocols using biotechnological interventions. This approach facilitates the large-scale, sustainable propagation of pharmacologically effective and safe sweet flag clones that comply with USFDA, WHO, and European Commission regulatory limits regarding ß-asarone toxicity.
KSCSTE.applications_&_industry_standard:
• Commercial cultivation of safe, regulatory-compliant medicinal herbs for agriculture

• Extraction of low-toxicity calamus oil for pharmaceutical and nutraceutical formulations

• Supply chains for traditional medicine and modern therapeutic manufacturing

• Sustainable mass-propagation services via commercial plant tissue culture labs
KSCSTE.key_benefits_&_value_proposition:
• Ensures compliance with USFDA and WHO safety limits by propagating specifically targeted low ß-asarone clones

• Enables rapid, large-scale commercial availability through standardized in vitro biotechnological multiplication

• Retains valuable pharmacological properties (neuroprotective, analgesic) while mitigating severe carcinogenic risks

• Secures a sustainable, high-quality supply chain for the pharmaceutical and traditional medicine industries

KSCSTE.technology_name: Herbal Drug for Comprehensive Wellness: Multi-Therapeutic Single-Herb Formulation
KSCSTE.institution: KSCSTE- Jawaharlal Nehru Tropical Botanic Garden & Research Institute (JNTBGRI)
KSCSTE.secondary_sector: Pharmaceuticals & Nutraceuticals
KSCSTE.problem_solved: The reliance on complex polyherbal mixtures or chemical-based synthetic drugs with potential side effects for managing pain, inflammation, and liver dysfunction.
KSCSTE.description: A novel, patented single-herb formulation developed to deliver broad-spectrum therapeutic effects without synthetic additives. Rich in flavonoids and polyphenols, the composition acts simultaneously as an anti-inflammatory (inhibiting COX-2 and TNF-a), analgesic, hepatoprotective, and antioxidant agent. It is manufactured in two standardized, user-friendly formats: oral granules for systemic treatment and topical ointment for localized application, merging traditional medicinal wisdom with scientific validation.
KSCSTE.applications_&_industry_standard:
• Commercial manufacturing of over-the-counter (OTC) phytopharmaceutical products

• Alternative medicine and holistic healthcare treatment therapies

• Production of natural, non-toxic topical ointments for localized pain relief

• Dietary and wellness supplements targeting liver health and oxidative stress
KSCSTE.key_benefits_&_value_proposition:
• Delivers multiple therapeutic benefits (analgesic, hepatoprotective, antioxidant) from a single natural source

• Provides flexible administration via dual formats (oral granules and topical ointment)

• Completely natural, non-toxic, and free from synthetic preservatives, ensuring safety for long-term use

• Strong intellectual property protection with a granted national patent backing its scientific efficacy

KSCSTE.technology_name: Probiotic from Infant Microbiome for Infection Prevention: Prophylactic/Adjuvant Formulation
KSCSTE.institution: KSCSTE- Centre of Excellence in Microbiome (CoEM)
KSCSTE.secondary_sector: Biotechnology & Life Sciences, Pharmaceuticals & Nutraceuticals
KSCSTE.problem_solved: The escalating global threat of multi-drug resistant bacterial infections and antibiotic resistance, particularly against last-resort antibiotics like colistin.
KSCSTE.description: A novel probiotic formulation derived from the infant gut microbiome developed as a prophylactic and adjuvant solution against multi-drug resistant pathogens. The lead strain exhibits potent broad-spectrum antimicrobial activity, notably against colistin-resistant Klebsiella pneumoniae, MRSA, drug-resistant Vibrio cholerae, Salmonella enterica, Shigella sonnei, and enteropathogenic E. coli. Comprehensive genome sequencing validates human safety by confirming the absolute absence of virulence factors and transferable antibiotic resistance genes.
KSCSTE.applications_&_industry_standard:
• Development of targeted therapeutic biotics and antibiotic adjuvants

• Formulation of premium functional foods and dietary health supplements

• Clinical pipelines for managing multi-drug resistant hospital infections

• Commercial out-licensing to healthcare enterprises and biotechnology firms
KSCSTE.contact_person: Dr. Karthika S & Dr. Sabu Thomas
KSCSTE.key_benefits_&_value_proposition:
• Demonstrates proven in vivo efficacy in reducing infection severity and preventing organ dissemination

• Provides a natural, safe alternative targeting critical, high-priority clinical pathogens

• Genome-sequenced validation ensures no risk of propagating secondary antibiotic resistance

• Highly versatile functionality suited for both pharmaceutical treatments and everyday wellness foods

KSCSTE.technology_name: Eco-Friendly Innovation in Incense Stick Production: Sustainable Binding Matrix
KSCSTE.institution: KSCSTE- Kerala Forest Research Institute (KFRI)
KSCSTE.secondary_sector: Consumer Goods & Crafts, Rural Livelihoods & Skill Development, Forestry & Biodiversity
KSCSTE.problem_solved: High cost and ecological unsustainability of traditional incense production relying on Jigat bark, combined with heavy accumulation of unutilized bamboo processing waste.
KSCSTE.description: A sustainable binding matrix formulation for incense sticks and cones that replaces traditional Jigat (Litsea glutinosa) bark with locally available Litsea deccanensis bark powder. The composition incorporates up to 70% repurposed waste bamboo sawdust and bamboo charcoal from unused inter-nodal portions. The semi-solid paste is coated onto 3 mm diameter bamboo sticks (15 cm coating line) and dried at 50°C for 3 hours, creating a clean-burning matrix that allows fragrance addition during or after production.
KSCSTE.applications_&_industry_standard:
• Commercial production of eco-friendly FMCG incense sticks (agarbatti) and cones (dhoop)

• Upcycling pipelines for industrial bamboo processing and wood mill waste

• Sustainable raw material provisioning for cottage industries and rural artisan clusters

• Development of bio-based alternative binder systems for consumer goods
KSCSTE.key_benefits_&_value_proposition:
• Repurposes up to 70% of structural bamboo waste, significantly lowering factory raw material costs

• Delivers a highly consistent 40-minute burn duration with minimized smoke emissions

• Achieves zero-waste manufacturing compatibility suitable for small-scale and decentralized producers

• Safeguards natural forest biomes from overharvesting by shifting away from traditional Jigat bark dependencies

KSCSTE.technology_name: Biopesticide Innovation for Sustainable Teak Protection: HpNPV Formulation
KSCSTE.institution: KSCSTE- Kerala Forest Research Institute (KFRI)
KSCSTE.secondary_sector: Forestry & Biodiversity, Biotechnology & Life Sciences
KSCSTE.problem_solved: Severe timber productivity and economic losses (up to ₹75,000 per hectare annually) in valuable teak plantations caused by the defoliator pest Hyblaea puera.
KSCSTE.description: An eco-friendly, biological pest control solution utilizing the host-specific Hyblaea puera Nucleopolyhedrovirus (HpNPV) which selectively destroys the targeted pest without impacting non-target or beneficial species. The virus attacks the third-instar larvae, inducing high mortality rates within three days. KFRI pioneered the extraction of virus-laden polyhedral inclusion bodies (PIBs) from mass-produced infected larvae to develop refined, freeze-dried wettable powder formulations optimized for field-spraying.
KSCSTE.applications_&_industry_standard:
• Large-scale integrated pest management (IPM) protocols for state forestry corporations

• Commercial biopesticide and biological control agent manufacturing pipelines

• Forestry protection management systems and predictive pest outbreak modeling service provisions

• Private commercial teak plantation maintenance contracts
KSCSTE.key_benefits_&_value_proposition:
• Offers strict host-specificity, ensuring complete ecological safety for beneficial forest species

• High potency formulation induces total target larval mortality within a narrow three-day window

• Replaces toxic synthetic chemical solutions with a patented, scientifically validated organic compound

• Early field applications reduce defoliator leaf damage by up to 76%, safeguarding annual timber yields

KSCSTE.technology_name: Eco-Friendly Blood Stain Removal: Bio-based Protease Enzyme
KSCSTE.institution: KSCSTE- Malabar Botanical Garden & Institute for Plant Sciences (MBGIPS)
KSCSTE.secondary_sector: Biotechnology & Life Sciences, Consumer Goods & Crafts
KSCSTE.problem_solved: Difficulty in effectively removing protein-rich blood stains using conventional chemical detergents, which pose environmental concerns and risk damaging fabrics.
KSCSTE.description: A biological stain-removal solution utilizing a novel protease enzyme extracted from the endophytic bacterium Bacillus altitudinis, isolated from the rhizosphere of the medicinal plant Lagenandra toxicaria. The enzyme targets blood stains by cleaving the peptide bonds in hemoglobin and associated proteins, converting them into water-soluble fragments easily washed away. It functions with high efficiency at ambient temperatures and achieves near-complete stain removal on cotton within 12 hours without causing fabric degradation.
KSCSTE.applications_&_industry_standard:
• Formulation ingredient for eco-friendly household laundry detergents

• Specialty stain-removal agents for commercial hospital and clinical laundry systems

• Industrial scale enzyme production for bio-cleaning solutions

• Additive optimization within green FMCG product lines
KSCSTE.key_benefits_&_value_proposition:
• Provides a fully biodegradable, environmentally safe alternative to toxic chemical cleaners

• Cleaves dense blood proteins down to water-soluble components for effortless washing

• Operates efficiently at ambient conditions without requiring high-temperature activation

• Cleans thoroughly while preserving the structural integrity and quality of cotton fabrics

KSCSTE.technology_name: Tropical Soil Scent: Bottling the Aroma of Rain (Petrichor)
KSCSTE.institution: KSCSTE- Jawaharlal Nehru Tropical Botanic Garden & Research Institute (JNTBGRI)
KSCSTE.secondary_sector: Biotechnology & Life Sciences, Consumer Goods & Crafts
KSCSTE.problem_solved: Heavy reliance on synthetic aromatic chemical formulations to recreate the natural, widely popular scent of rain on dry earth (petrichor).
KSCSTE.description: Identification and extraction of naturally occurring geosmin from a plant-based source instead of conventional soil bacteria. The essential oil extract was chemically validated using Gas Chromatography-Mass Spectrometry (GC-MS) to ensure a high-fidelity, crude yet authentic petrichor profile rich in volatile components. This botanical formulation replaces standard petroleum-derived fragrance syntheses with a green, scalable alternative.
KSCSTE.applications_&_industry_standard:
• High-end perfumery and fine fragrance manufacturing formulation collections

• Aromatherapy formulations, functional wellness items, and spa cosmetic lines

• Eco-friendly room misters, diffusers, and premium FMCG home fragrance lines

• Natural raw material sourcing pipelines for international cosmetic brands
KSCSTE.key_benefits_&_value_proposition:
• Replaces harsh synthetic fragrance chemicals with a 100% plant-derived, biodegradable volatile profile

• Scientifically verified via GC-MS tracking to guarantee precise olfactory consistency and genuine petrichor output

• Leverages profound psychological, memory-evoking consumer attachments to monsoons and natural landscapes

• Highly compatible with growing consumer macro-trends demanding transparent, green, and ethically sourced raw ingredients

KSCSTE.technology_name: Eco-Friendly Dry Flower Hamper (Aqua Florea)
KSCSTE.institution: KSCSTE- Malabar Botanical Garden & Institute for Plant Sciences (MBGIPS)
KSCSTE.secondary_sector: Forestry & Biodiversity, Rural Livelihoods & Skill Development, Consumer Goods & Crafts
KSCSTE.problem_solved: Proliferation of the invasive strawflower (Xerochrysum bracteatum) threatening native biodiversity in regions like the Nilgiris, combined with the high environmental footprint of synthetic/plastic gifts.
KSCSTE.description: An eco-friendly corporate and academic memento/hamper handcrafted from locally sourced dried flora and foliage. The primary material utilizes the vibrant, long-lasting petals of the invasive strawflower, converting an ecological threat into a value-added consumer product. The manufacturing process is entirely manual, chemical-free, and designed for decentralized production by local women's self-help groups.
KSCSTE.applications_&_industry_standard:
• Sustainable corporate gifting and institutional mementos for events

• Souvenirs for eco-tourism hubs, botanical gardens, and heritage sites

• Commercial handcrafted decoration and sustainable FMCG lifestyle products

• Green skill development and rural livelihood programs
KSCSTE.contact_person: Dr. Manjula K M & Dr. Raghupathi B
KSCSTE.key_benefits_&_value_proposition:
• Transforms an aggressive, biodiversity-displacing invasive plant into a premium commercial asset

• Product lifecycle is fully chemical-free and biodegradable, eliminating plastic gift waste

• Empowers vulnerable rural communities and women through structured craft entrepreneurship models

• Directly embeds an environmental conservation narrative into institutional and academic gifting

KSCSTE.technology_name: GI Registered Kannadippaya (Bamboo Mat): From Mats to Wall Hangings
KSCSTE.institution: KSCSTE- Kerala Forest Research Institute (KFRI)
KSCSTE.secondary_sector: Consumer Goods & Crafts, Rural Livelihoods & Skill Development, Forestry & Biodiversity
KSCSTE.problem_solved: Preservation of traditional tribal heritage crafts, economic marginalization of indigenous artisans, and the loss of eco-friendly consumer alternatives to synthetic lifestyle products.
KSCSTE.description: A traditional heritage bamboo mat craft known as Kannadippaya, historically woven by five Scheduled Tribe communities (Oorali, Mannan, Muthuva, Malayan, and Kadar) using fine slivers of thin-walled reed bamboo (Teinostachyum wightii) harvested from the Western Ghats. The hallmark of this craft is its intricate "kannadi" (mirror) square motifs created by interweaving warp and weft patterns into complex layouts with over sixty diagonal and reflective motifs. The mats feature light-reflective qualities and extreme physical flexibility.
KSCSTE.applications_&_industry_standard:
• Premium eco-friendly consumer lifestyle products (sleeping, yoga, and table mats)

• High-end residential and commercial interior design installations or decorative wall hangings

• Sustainable corporate gifting and premium cultural boutique product lines

• Global luxury ethnic handicrafts and eco-tourism retail markets
KSCSTE.key_benefits_&_value_proposition:
• Formally protected and validated by a registered Geographical Indication (GI) tag, ensuring authenticity and market value premium

• Employs 100% natural, biodegradable, and sustainably sourced thin-walled reed bamboo raw materials

• Superior fiber flexibility allows fine mats to be completely rolled and stored inside a compact bamboo culm without splitting

• Directly anchors and scales economic livelihoods and entrepreneurship for five marginalized indigenous tribal communities

KSCSTE.technology_name: Advanced Electrode Platform for Fast-Charging Supercapacitors: TiO2 Nanotube Arrays
KSCSTE.institution: KSCSTE - Srinivasa Ramanujan Institute for Basic Sciences
KSCSTE.secondary_sector: Energy Storage & Battery Tech, Nanotechnology & Advanced Materials
KSCSTE.problem_solved: The need for scalable, high-performance, and cyclically stable electrodes with high energy and power densities for next-generation fast-charging supercapacitors.
KSCSTE.description: A novel temperature-controlled water bath anodization technique to synthesize high-performance TiO2 nanotube array (TNTA) electrodes. This approach induces in-situ crystallization, forming a mixed-phase structure (monoclinic TiO2(B) and orthorhombic Brookite) that supports both pseudocapacitive ion intercalation and surface redox reactions. The technology utilizes high oxygen vacancies and doping strategies, achieving outstanding specific capacitance (up to 916.27 F/g) and massive energy densities (up to 509 Wh/kg).
KSCSTE.applications_&_industry_standard:
• Manufacturing of next-generation fast-charging supercapacitors

• Advanced energy storage systems for electric vehicles (EVs) and hybrid power grids

• High-performance power components for portable electronics and medical devices

• Commercial nanomaterial synthesis and electrode fabrication pipelines
KSCSTE.key_benefits_&_value_proposition:
• Delivers exceptionally high energy density (up to 509 Wh/kg) and power density (2.9 kW/kg) for rapid-charging applications

• Innovative water bath anodization enables direct in-situ crystallization, eliminating complex secondary heating steps

• Exhibits superior cyclic stability driven by dual pseudocapacitance mechanisms and structural oxygen vacancies

• Validated self-doping enhancements provide highly scalable manufacturing pathways for commercial electrode arrays

KSCSTE.technology_name: Smart Traffic Signal System for Emergency Vehicle Priority
KSCSTE.institution: KSCSTE - National Transportation Planning and Research Centre (NATPAC)
KSCSTE.secondary_sector: GIS & Geospatial Systems, Smart Transportation, Emergency Response Systems
KSCSTE.problem_solved: Traffic congestion delays at urban signal junctions that prolong emergency vehicle response times during life-critical windows.
KSCSTE.description: An Emergency Vehicle Priority System (EVPS) developed in collaboration with KELTRON that dynamically grants right-of-way to emergency vehicles. The system utilizes real-time GPS coordinates mapped to specific junction arms.
