When an ambulance entering the zone is detected, the vehicle unit communicates with the intersection controller to trigger a pre-emptive "hurry call" sequence, overriding standard signal cycles to clear traffic ahead of the vehicle.
KSCSTE.applications_&_industry_standard:
• Municipal Smart City infrastructure upgrades and traffic control networks

• Centralized emergency vehicle fleet management and tracking systems

• Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) commercial signaling hardware installations

• Prioritized transit routing systems for fire, rescue, and public safety fleets
KSCSTE.key_benefits_&_value_proposition:
• Delivers significant time savings ranging from 10 to 25 seconds per monitored intersection corridor

• Seamlessly integrates into pre-existing traffic control systems without disrupting established road infrastructure

• Employs high-precision GPS boundary tracking to prevent false triggers from non-approaching vehicles

• Directly mitigates corridor-wide cascading delays for critical medical transportation in dense urban zones

KSCSTE.technology_name: Kerala Transportation Database Management System (KTDMS)
KSCSTE.institution: KSCSTE - National Transportation Planning and Research Centre (NATPAC)
KSCSTE.secondary_sector: GIS & Geospatial Systems, AI/ML & Data Analytics, Smart Transportation, Urban Mobility
KSCSTE.problem_solved: Fragmented, inefficient manual data collection and the lack of centralized spatial analysis for critical road assets, traffic volumes, and crash statistics.
KSCSTE.description: A comprehensive, GIS-based web and mobile ecosystem designed for strategic road asset management. KTDMS integrates a Road Asset Management System (RAMS) built on a service-oriented architecture (SOA). Field surveyors use custom Android applications to log timestamped traffic volumes, parking data, and road inventory. This data syncs instantly to a centralized web platform equipped with analytical modules to assess vehicle/pedestrian volumes and evaluate traffic signal warrants.
KSCSTE.applications_&_industry_standard:
• State transport and public works departments (PWD) for highway asset maintenance

• Municipal corporations and Smart City urban planning boards

• Traffic police and road safety authorities for crash mapping and mitigation

• CivicTech consulting and urban infrastructure development agencies
KSCSTE.contact_person: Mr. Sanjay Kumar V S & Mr. Ebin Sam S
KSCSTE.key_benefits_&_value_proposition:
• Provides a unified, real-time ecosystem connecting mobile field data collection directly to a web analytics dashboard

• Leverages advanced GIS mapping to visually track infrastructure wear, pavement details, and high-risk crash zones

• Eliminates disjointed manual traffic surveys with precision timestamped mobile tracking

• Enables evidence-based, rapid policy decisions for infrastructure upgrades and traffic signal deployments

KSCSTE.technology_name: Smart Speed Display Boards for Safer Roads at Critical Locations
KSCSTE.institution: KSCSTE - National Transportation Planning and Research Centre (NATPAC)
KSCSTE.secondary_sector: AI/ML & Data Analytics, Smart Transportation, Road Safety
KSCSTE.problem_solved: Rising road accidents at black spots and critical curves driven by overspeeding and a lack of real-time driver velocity feedback.
KSCSTE.description: A system deployment and behavioral study of Dynamic Speed Display Boards (DSDBs) that provide real-time speed feedback to passing drivers. The system's efficacy is anchored in a psychological behavioral framework analyzed using a Structural Equation Model (SEM). The model establishes that a driver's Attitude towards DSDB (ATD), Subjective Norms (SBN), and Perceived Behavioural Control (PBC) strongly drive the Intention (INT) to slow down, directly translating to measurable Speed Reduction Behaviour (SPR) at accident-prone locations.
KSCSTE.applications_&_industry_standard:
• Smart highway networks, sharp curves, and high-risk accident black spots

• School zones, hospital corridors, and pedestrian-heavy urban intersections

• Municipal traffic calming initiatives and smart-city speed enforcement networks

• Telematics data collection for highway planning and safety optimization
KSCSTE.key_benefits_&_value_proposition:
• Provides direct, radar-driven visual cues that immediately trigger driver self-correction loops

• Grounded in a verified SEM psychological model proving high correlation between real-time feedback and actual brake activation

• Enhances Perceived Behavioural Control (PBC), giving drivers an active sense of mastery over speed compliance

• Demonstrates consistent overspeeding reduction across all demographics and vehicle categories without requiring punitive fines

KSCSTE.technology_name: Sustainable Construction Materials from Industrial Waste (CLSM)
KSCSTE.institution: KSCSTE - National Transportation Planning and Research Centre (NATPAC)
KSCSTE.secondary_sector: Waste Management & Sanitation
KSCSTE.problem_solved: Disposing of massive quantities of construction debris (concrete/quarry waste) while addressing the difficulty of backfilling tight utility trenches where mechanical soil compaction is impossible.
KSCSTE.description: Controlled Low-Strength Materials (CLSM) are self-compacting, highly flowable cementitious slurries engineered to replace compacted soil backfills. This specific innovation optimizes a low-cement mix using industrial byproducts: 30% fly ash, 50% quarry waste, and 20% concrete waste with just 3% cement. The formulation maintains a high flowability of 250 mm and is physically engineered to stay below a strict 28-day compressive strength ceiling (0.7 MPa) to ensure it can be easily dug out later using standard hand tools.
KSCSTE.applications_&_industry_standard:
• Self-leveling backfills for underground utility, pipe, and cable trenches

• Structural fill for abandoned underground storage tanks, mines, and basements

• Eco-friendly sub-base layers for municipal road construction and sidewalks

• Commercial formulation manufacturing for green ready-mix concrete suppliers
KSCSTE.key_benefits_&_value_proposition:
• Upcycles heavy concrete debris and structural quarry waste away from urban landfills into functional infrastructure assets

• Completely eliminates the need for mechanical vibrators or rollers due to its self-compacting, high-flow profile

• Capped compressive strength (< 0.7 MPa) guarantees seamless re-excavation with hand tools for future utility repairs

• Leverages pozzolanic reactions from fly ash to achieve reliable structural stability with minimized costly cement binder

KSCSTE.technology_name: Compact Wind Energy Solution for Residential Power Needs (2.5 kW VAWT)
KSCSTE.institution: Integrated Rural Technology centre (IRTC)
KSCSTE.secondary_sector: Climate Action & Carbon Sequestration, Renewable Energy Generation
KSCSTE.problem_solved: The lack of decentralized, space-efficient wind energy alternatives suitable for residential use to complement existing rooftop solar systems.
KSCSTE.description: A compact 2.5 kW Vertical Axis Wind Turbine (VAWT) designed specifically for household and small commercial deployment. Utilizing high-performance magnets imported from Germany, the prototype is optimized for a 10-meter installation height. Under favorable wind conditions, the system generates approximately 25 kWh of electricity daily, providing a highly effective, decentralized green power generation solution.
KSCSTE.applications_&_industry_standard:
• Residential rooftop power generation and hybrid solar-wind microgrids

• Decentralized energy systems for small commercial and agricultural facilities

• Localized hardware manufacturing, component import, and assembly businesses

• Off-grid rural electrification initiatives
startup_potential: High potential for green hardware manufacturing startups
KSCSTE.key_benefits_&_value_proposition:
• Vertical-axis configuration allows for safe, compact installation in dense residential environments unlike massive horizontal turbines

• Capable of generating up to 25 kWh per day, offering significant household energy independence

• Perfectly complements existing rooftop solar grid infrastructures for a more stable, 24/7 renewable power supply

• Scalable model designed to trigger local job creation through small-scale regional manufacturing and assembly units

KSCSTE.technology_name: Evaluation of Traffic Calming Techniques for Safer Roads
KSCSTE.institution: KSCSTE - National Transportation Planning and Research Centre (NATPAC)
KSCSTE.secondary_sector: Smart Transportation, Road Safety
KSCSTE.problem_solved: High vehicle speeds and elevated accident rates at critical road segments such as sharp curves, commercial areas, and school zones.
KSCSTE.description: A comprehensive evaluation and regression modeling study analyzing the real-world performance of three common Traffic Calming Measures (TCMs): Speed Humps, Speed Tables, and Transverse Bar Markings (TBMs) across 21 critical locations in Kerala. Free-flow speed data extracted via drone videography and spatial tracking software (Kinovea and Data from Sky) was paired with 3-year pre- and post-implementation crash data. Multiple linear regression models prove that structural height increases speed reduction, whereas structural width decreases its efficacy.
KSCSTE.applications_&_industry_standard:
• Urban planning and municipal civil engineering layout designs

• National and state highway speed-management regulation updates

• Public works safety audits for school zones and dense residential centers

• Smart city traffic engineering guidelines and infrastructure deployment
startup_potential: Medium potential for civil engineering consultancy firms
KSCSTE.key_benefits_&_value_proposition:
• Proves Speed Humps and Speed Tables drop vehicle velocities significantly by 64% and 58.4% respectively

• Empirically correlates structural implementation to a massive ~40% reduction in localized traffic crashes

• Establishes that Speed Tables provide the optimal balance between high safety margins and smooth transit profiles

• Leverages statistical regression modeling to guide engineers away from ineffective, wide, or flush pavement geometries

KSCSTE.technology_name: Evaluating Road Safety Using Surrogate Measures on Two-Lane Highways
KSCSTE.institution: KSCSTE - National Transportation Planning and Research Centre (NATPAC)
KSCSTE.secondary_sector: GIS & Geospatial Systems, Smart Transportation, Road Safety
KSCSTE.problem_solved: High accident rates of motorized two-wheelers (MTWs) on congested corridors and the lack of empirical metrics to quantify near-miss collision risks before crashes occur.
KSCSTE.description: An operational and safety evaluation of dedicated, inclusive Motorized Two-Wheeler (MTW) lanes marked within standard two-lane highway carriageways (pilot-tested on the Muvattupuzha-Vengalloor stretch). The framework utilizes drone videography and GIS risk mapping paired with advanced surrogate safety metrics—specifically Time-to-Collision (TTC)—to isolate spatial conflict points (such as the Kothamangalam junction) where car-to-MTW interactions reach a critical average TTC threshold of 1.34 seconds.
KSCSTE.applications_&_industry_standard:
• Highway design modification guidelines and smart corridor planning

• Streamlines industrial project compliance via NABET-accredited Environmental Impact Assessments (EIA) for river valley zones

KSCSTE.technology_name: Decision Support System for Technology Valuation
KSCSTE.institution: KSCSTE- Centre for Water Resources Development and Management (CWRDM)
KSCSTE.secondary_sector: IP Valuation & Tech Transfer, R&D Strategic Planning, Data Analytics & Optimization
KSCSTE.problem_solved: The complexity, ambiguity, and lack of standardized frameworks for accurately calculating the financial value of newly developed scientific technologies and IP for commercialization.
KSCSTE.description: A sophisticated Decision Support System (DSS) algorithm designed to value intellectual assets and patents developed in public research institutions. The software synthesizes variables like development costs, market conditions, and future cash flows to compute a fair commercial value. It features a custom matrix for fixing royalty ranges and automatically fetches default macroeconomic data (depreciation, bank rates) if specific inputs are missing, outputting a comprehensive PDF valuation report.
KSCSTE.applications_&_industry_standard:
• Technology Transfer Offices (TTOs) negotiating licensing deals with startups

• Corporate R&D strategic planning and technology pricing

• Financial securitization, IP taxation, and venture capital auditing

• Legal settlements for patent infringement lawsuits
startup_potential: Low (Functions as an institutional administrative tool for internal tech-transfer rather than a consumer spin-off)
KSCSTE.key_benefits_&_value_proposition:
• Eliminates the guesswork in technology transfer negotiations by providing a mathematically sound, data-driven IP baseline price

• Automatically fills in missing economic variables from an integrated database, streamlining the valuation process for non-financial researchers

• Incorporates a novel, proprietary matrix specifically designed for calculating fair and competitive royalty ranges

• Instantly generates formal, legally and financially formatted PDF valuation reports required for mergers, acquisitions, and licensing

niist.technology_name: Millet-Based Functional Food Formulations
niist.institution: CSIR-National Institute for Interdisciplinary Science and Technology (NIIST)
niist.technology_type: Process Technology, Ready to prepare food, Functional Food
niist.problem_solved: Need for ready to prepare functional foods from traditional grains to aid in the prevention and management of lifestyle-associated diseases.
niist.description: Processes for the development of traditional millet-based and indigenous vegetable-based ready-to-prepare products, including soup mix, porridge, and upma. Traditional grains are sprouted, dehydrated, milled, and formulated into a variety of products that can be used as functional food for potential health benefits.
applications: • Manufacturing of commercial functional breakfast mixes • Production of ready-to-prepare therapeutic soup formulas • Processing of specialized geriatric and pediatric nutrition products • Formulation of value-added traditional grain snacks

niist.technology_name: Dehumidified Dryer Technology for Agricultural Crops
niist.institution: CSIR-National Institute for Interdisciplinary Science and Technology (NIIST)
niist.problem_solved: Inefficient crop drying methods that lead to loss of nutrients and high energy consumption.
niist.description: A dehumidified dryer system for agricultural crops operating via a refrigeration system. It circulates dehumidified air at 40-50°C using a finned tube heat exchanger, evaporator, and condenser.
applications: • Processing and post-harvest drying of commercial fruits • Dehydration of high-value plantation spices and herbs • Preservation drying of ornamental flowers and botanicals • Integration into small-scale decentralized agro-processing units

niist.technology_name: Microbial White Pepper Production Technology
niist.institution: CSIR-National Institute for Interdisciplinary Science and Technology (NIIST)
niist.problem_solved: Need for an efficient and environmentally clean process for the de-skinning of pepper.
niist.description: A zero-discharge microbial bioprocess for white pepper production where fermentative de-skinning of pepper takes place. The technology has been awarded the NRDC technology Award and the WIPO Gold medal (2009).
applications: • Industrial processing of premium white pepper grades • Manufacturing of specialized biological retting formulations • Deployment in eco-friendly
zero-discharge spice processing centers • Commercial cultivation value-addition loops for pepper farmers

niist.technology_name: Red Palmolein (RPO) Functional Food Technology
niist.institution: CSIR-National Institute for Interdisciplinary Science and Technology (NIIST)
niist.problem_solved: Vitamin A deficiency and malnutrition in women and children.
niist.description: A cost-effective process to produce Red Palmolein (RPO) as a functional food source of Vitamin A and Vitamin E. The process involves neutralization, winterization, filtration, and low-temperature vacuum deodorization of crude palm oil, utilized as a dietary approach through blended oil.
applications: • Production of fortified edible blended cooking oils • Manufacturing of nutritional supplements combating vitamin deficiencies • Formulation of nutrient-dense ingredients for public food programs • Processing of high-carotene functional food oil bases

niist.technology_name: Raw Banana Composite Mix Production Technology
niist.institution: CSIR-National Institute for Interdisciplinary Science and Technology (NIIST)
niist.problem_solved: Need for low-glycemic functional foods for diabetes management using value-added banana products.
niist.description: Processes for the development of a raw banana composite mix. The technology utilizes green banana pulp, which contains 70-80% starch, processed using milling, boiling, drying, and mixing equipment to create functional foods.
applications: • Production of low-glycemic clinical nutrition foods • Manufacturing of specialized diabetic-friendly meal mixes • Processing of value-added functional green banana flours • Formulation of therapeutic therapeutic-grade food bases

niist.technology_name: Raw Banana Peel Powder Production Technology
niist.institution: CSIR-National Institute for Interdisciplinary Science and Technology (NIIST)
niist.problem_solved: Underutilization of banana peel and the need for fiber-rich functional food ingredients.
niist.description: Processes for the development of raw banana peel powder. The technology processes green banana peel using size reduction devices, milling, boiling, and drying to develop functional food products.
applications: • Manufacturing of high-fiber baking ingredient supplements • Processing of agro-industrial waste into functional foods • Formulation of dietary fiber-enriched nutraceutical bases • Production of botanical phytochemical extracts for food fortification

niist.technology_name: Raw Banana Grits for Porridges Production Technology
niist.institution: CSIR-National Institute for Interdisciplinary Science and Technology (NIIST)
niist.problem_solved: Need for low-glycemic functional foods for diabetes management using value-added banana products.
niist.description: Processes for the development of dehydrated and powdered raw banana functional breakfast mixes, such as grits for porridges. The technology utilizes green banana pulp, which contains up to 70-80% starch, processed using size reduction devices, milling, boiling, and drying equipment to create functional health foods.
applications: • Manufacturing of commercial therapeutic breakfast porridges • Processing of low-glycemic health-mix grits • Production of clean-label instant packaged hot cereals • Value-addition processing loops for commercial banana farming

niist.technology_name: Raw Banana and Cereal-Based Instant Drink Production Technology
niist.institution: CSIR-National Institute for Interdisciplinary Science and Technology (NIIST)
niist.problem_solved: Need for low-glycemic functional foods for diabetes management using value-added banana products.
niist.description: Processes for the development of raw banana and cereal instant drinks. The technology utilizes green banana pulp, which contains up to 70-80% starch, processed using size reduction devices, milling, boiling, and drying equipment to create functional health foods.
applications: • Manufacturing of low-glycemic powdered instant beverage mixes • Production of RTD (Ready-to-Drink) therapeutic health drinks • Processing of value-added grain-and-fruit functional beverages • Formulation of specialized clinical health nutrition powders

niist.technology_name: Natural Fibre Production Bioprocess from Agro Waste
niist.institution: CSIR-National Institute for Interdisciplinary Science and Technology (NIIST)
niist.technology_type: Process Technology, Biological Resource, Waste/Resource Recovery System
niist.problem_solved: Environmental pollution and long processing times associated with traditional fibre extraction from agro waste.
niist.description: An anaerobic bioprocess for the production of natural fibre from agro waste. The technology utilizes retting tanks in parallel and an anaerobic reactor to extract coir, banana, and pineapple fibres while generating biogas as a value-added by-product in a zero-discharge system.
applications: • Accelerated processing of natural coir fiber • Rapid extraction of agricultural banana and pineapple fibers • Anaerobic generation of industrial and municipal biogas fuel • Treatment and resource recovery of agricultural biomass waste

niist.technology_name: Fresh Ginger Value Addition and Dry Powder Production Technology
niist.institution: CSIR-National Institute for Interdisciplinary Science and Technology (NIIST)
niist.problem_solved: Need for removal of adhering mud and enhancement of shelf life for fresh ginger.
niist.description: A continuous or batch-wise process for washing, cleaning, waxing, grading, and drying fresh ginger. The operations involve mechanical dewatering, sorting by size, powdering for smaller ginger, and optional waxing of larger ginger to produce a superior grade market product.
applications: • Continuous cleaning and post-harvest washing of raw ginger • Industrial processing of premium dry ginger powders • Automated grading and surface waxing of export-grade ginger • Dehydration and mechanical dewatering of root spice crops

niist.technology_name: Spice-Fortified Coconut and Palm Sap Syrup Production Technology
niist.institution: CSIR-National Institute for Interdisciplinary Science and Technology (NIIST)
niist.problem_solved: Need for functional syrup products that offer digestive benefits and soothe coughs.
niist.description: A process to produce spices fortified syrup by concentrating the sap of coconut or palmyra palm. The sap is fortified with spices and liquid glucose using equipment such as a jacketed kettle, crusher, and centrifuge.
applications: • Production of specialized health and functional culinary syrups • Manufacturing of ingredient bases for instant traditional coffees • Processing of value-added coconut and palmyra palm sap products • Formulation of natural herbal-fortified sweetening agents

niist.technology_name: Trikatu Syrup Production Technology from Palm Neera
niist.institution: CSIR-National Institute for Interdisciplinary Science and Technology (NIIST)
niist.problem_solved: Need for palatable delivery methods for the medicinal properties of unfermented palm tree sap and Trikatu.
niist.description: A technology know-how for making Trikatu syrup utilizing Palm Neera (unfermented palm tree sap), dry ginger, pepper, and long pepper. The formulation provides the richness and medicinal properties of Palm Neera in a palatable form.
applications: • Manufacturing of traditional Ayurvedic medical syrups • Formulation of clinical respiratory health-support therapeutics • Production of biological bioavailability-enhancing syrup bases • Processing of unfermented palm tree sap into shelf-stable liquid forms

niist.technology_name: Process Development and Optimization Service for Fruit and Vegetable Value Addition
niist.institution: CSIR-National Institute for Interdisciplinary Science and Technology (NIIST)
niist.problem_solved: Need for scaling up, optimizing drying kinetics, and evaluating shelf stability for processed fruit and vegetable products.
niist.description: Institutional technical services providing process development for dehydration, scale-up optimization of drying kinetics, energy calculation, costing, and shelf-stability evaluation of processed fruit and vegetable products.
applications: • Deployment of optimization models for industrial fruit drying kinetics • Engineering scale-up testing for vegetable dehydration plants • Auditing and validation of processed food shelf-stability parameters • Commercial engineering and costing calculations for agro-processors

niist.technology_name: Coconut Residue Dietary Fiber Recovery Technology
niist.institution: CSIR-National Institute for Interdisciplinary Science and Technology (NIIST)
niist.problem_solved: Need for better utilization of industrial by-products from the virgin coconut oil industry.
niist.description: A process for the recovery of high-value dietary fiber from spent coconut residue, a by-product of the virgin coconut oil industry. The process involves oil removal and pre-treatment operations to produce an enriched dietary fiber and protein product using extraction units and jacketed vessels.
applications: • Processing of industrial virgin coconut oil by-products • Manufacturing of high-value dietary fiber supplements • Production of enriched protein food additives • Formulation of functional food ingredients from agricultural waste

niist.technology_name: Essential Oil Recovery Technology for Spices and Aromatic Plants
niist.institution: CSIR-National Institute for Interdisciplinary Science and Technology (NIIST)
niist.problem_solved: Need for economically viable, small-scale multipurpose extraction of essential oils to generate income for farmers.
niist.description: Technology for the recovery of flavour and essential oils from various spices and aromatic plants (like ginger, pepper, cardamom, betel leaf, etc.) using a small scale multipurpose distillation facility.
applications: • Manufacturing of spice flavors and oleoresins • Production of essential oils for perfumery • Processing of botanical extracts for medicinal applications • Deployment in small-scale rural multipurpose distillation facilities

niist.technology_name: Coconut and Palm Sap Syrup Production Technology
niist.institution: CSIR-National Institute for Interdisciplinary Science and Technology (NIIST)
niist.problem_solved: Need for a uniform quality, melt-free alternative to conventional palm ghur/jaggery.
niist.description: A process to produce a sweetener syrup by concentrating the sap of coconut or palmyra palm. The syrup retains uniform quality and can be used directly without the melting and filtration steps required for conventional palm ghur.
applications: • Production of natural liquid sweeteners for direct consumption • Manufacturing of commercial confectionery ingredients • Processing of traditional instant coffee formulations • Formulation of alternatives to conventional palm ghur and jaggery

niist.technology_name: Dehydration Technology for Nutmeg and Cardamom Value Addition
niist.institution: CSIR-National Institute for Interdisciplinary Science and Technology (NIIST)
niist.problem_solved: Quality constraints in global markets due to aflatoxins and essential oil loss during conventional spice drying.
niist.description: A dehydration process and drying unit for spices like nutmeg and cardamom. The unit operates with less energy consumption to produce moisture and aflatoxin-free spices while preventing the oozing out of essential oils.
applications: • Post-harvest processing of export-grade spices • Manufacturing of aflatoxin-free dried nutmeg and cardamom • Dehydration of high-value agricultural produce • Deployment in commercial spice drying and export facilities

niist.technology_name: Dehydrated Unripe Jackfruit Production Technology
niist.institution: CSIR-National Institute for Interdisciplinary Science and Technology (NIIST)
niist.problem_solved: Limited shelf life and loss of freshness of unripe matured and tender jackfruit.
niist.description: A process for the production of ready-to-cook dehydrated unripe and tender jackfruit. The process utilizes a drier, slicer, and steamer, allowing the product to be vacuum packaged in flexible polyethylene bags without added preservatives.
applications: • Manufacturing of ready-to-cook packaged fruit products • Processing of dehydrated base ingredients for commercial curries • Production of preservative-free shelf-stable tropical fruits • Deployment in post-harvest agricultural value-addition facilities

niist.technology_name: Honey-Preserved Dehydrated Ripe Jackfruit Technology
niist.institution: CSIR-National Institute for Interdisciplinary Science and Technology (NIIST)
niist.problem_solved: Degradation of fresh and natural flavors in ripe jackfruit over time.
niist.description: A process where ripe jackfruit is dehydrated to an optimum moisture level and water activity using novel drying methods, and then preserved in honey. The product is packaged in standalone polyethylene bags.
applications: • Manufacturing of commercial honey-preserved fruit snacks • Production of premium shelf-stable tropical fruit preserves • Processing of preservative-free natural sweet confections • Formulation of value-added agricultural export products

niist.technology_name: Ready-to-Cook Dehydrated Vegetables Technology
niist.institution: CSIR-National Institute for Interdisciplinary Science and Technology (NIIST)
niist.problem_solved: High perishability of vegetables leading to material and economic loss.
niist.description: A technology for producing ready-to-cook dehydrated vegetables, such as carrot, raw banana, yam, and snake gourd. The process uses a jacketed kettle with agitation, RADD, and a vacuum packaging machine to extend shelf life.
applications: • Manufacturing of instant ready-to-cook vegetable mixes • Production of dehydrated ingredients for commercial soups and meals • Processing of shelf-stable emergency food supplies • Deployment in post-harvest agricultural loss reduction centers

niist.technology_name: Raw Banana-Based Functional Food Products Technology
niist.institution: CSIR-National Institute for Interdisciplinary Science and Technology (NIIST)
niist.problem_solved: Need for low-glycemic functional foods for diabetes management.
niist.description: Processes for the development of dehydrated and powdered raw banana functional breakfast mixes and health products. The technology processes green banana pulp using size reduction devices, milling, and drying.
applications: • Manufacturing of low-glycemic therapeutic breakfast mixes • Production of functional green banana powder ingredients • Processing of clinical nutrition foods for diabetes management • Formulation of digestive health supplements

niist.technology_name: Osmo-Dehydrated Dry Fruit Production Technology
niist.institution: CSIR-National Institute for Interdisciplinary Science and Technology (NIIST)
niist.problem_solved: Seasonal unavailability of fruits and the need to preserve their high quality and eating characteristics year-round.
niist.description: A process combining osmotic dehydration and dehumidified drying to produce high-quality dry fruits. The technology processes raw fruit with sugar syrup using a jacketed kettle, RADD, and vacuum packaging to ensure product availability throughout the year.
applications: • Manufacturing of premium shelf-stable fruit snacks • Production of commercial ice cream and confectionery toppings • Processing of year-round fruit preservation bases • Deployment in post-harvest agricultural value-addition units

niist.technology_name: Ready-to-Cook Dehydrated Leafy Vegetables Technology
niist.institution: CSIR-National Institute for Interdisciplinary Science and Technology (NIIST)
niist.problem_solved: High perishability of leafy vegetables leading to material waste and economic loss.
niist.description: A process for producing ready-to-cook dehydrated leafy vegetables such as amaranth, spinach, coriander, fenugreek, and mint. The technology extends the shelf life of highly perishable greens using a jacketed kettle with agitation, RADD, and vacuum packaging.
applications: • Manufacturing of instant ready-to-cook vegetable ingredients • Production of commercial dried herbs and seasonings • Processing of shelf-stable emergency food supplies • Formulation of dehydrated ingredients for packaged food products

niist.technology_name: Health Management Spice Seasoning Mix Formulation
niist.institution: CSIR-National Institute for Interdisciplinary Science and Technology (NIIST)
niist.problem_solved: Need for preventive health management products addressing antidiabetic and cardiovascular issues through daily diet.
niist.description: A seasoning mix formulated by blending various herbs, spices, and medicinal plants in unique proportions based on their evaluated antioxidant, antidiabetic, and cardiovascular protection properties. The manufacturing utilizes equipment like sorters, slicers, hammer mills, and blenders.
applications: • Manufacturing of therapeutic and functional culinary seasonings • Production of health-oriented salad dressings and soup bases • Formulation of functional toppings for commercial snacks like popcorn • Processing of preventive health ingredients for ready-to-eat foods

niist.technology_name: Microencapsulated Functional Beverage Technology
niist.institution: CSIR-National Institute for Interdisciplinary Science and Technology (NIIST)
niist.problem_solved: Need for accessible functional health drinks with antidiabetic and cardiovascular protection properties.
niist.description: A process for creating functional beverages by microencapsulating tropical fruit juices, such as jamun and pomegranate, with extracts of herbs, spices, and medicinal plants. The formulation is blended in unique proportions to encapsulate active ingredients using stirred tank vessels and spray driers.
applications: • Manufacturing of ready-to-constitute therapeutic health drinks • Production of microencapsulated functional beverage powders • Formulation of specialized clinical nutrition juices • Processing of bioactive-rich plant ingredients for the beverage industry

niist.technology_name: Spice-Based Green Tea Bag Dips Technology
niist.institution: CSIR-National Institute for Interdisciplinary Science and Technology (NIIST)
niist.problem_solved: Need for functional tea beverages with antidiabetic health benefits.
niist.description: Processes for producing green tea and spice bag dips blended with herbs, spices, and medicinal plants. The formulation encapsulates active ingredients evaluated for antidiabetic properties, processed using milling, drying, and packing equipment.
applications: • Manufacturing of functional antidiabetic tea blends • Production of microencapsulated herbal tea bags • Processing of therapeutic botanical beverages • Formulation of clinical health and wellness drinks

niist.technology_name: Endophytic Bacterial Formulation for Plant Tonic
niist.institution: CSIR-National Institute for Interdisciplinary Science and Technology (NIIST)
niist.problem_solved: Soil fertility deterioration and undesirable agricultural changes caused by excessive use of synthetic compounds.
niist.description: A plant tonic formulation comprising a consortium of three endophytic microbial strains isolated from rice plants in the Kuttanad region. The endophytes reside inside the plant, offering an eco-friendly alternative to synthetic agricultural chemicals.
applications: • Manufacturing of commercial biological crop tonics • Production of eco-friendly microbial biofertilizers • Formulation of biological disease management sprays • Cultivation and farming using green agriculture practices

niist.technology_name: Millet-Based Ready-to-Eat (RTE) Porridge Technology
niist.institution: CSIR-National Institute for Interdisciplinary Science and Technology (NIIST)
niist.problem_solved: Need for instantly available, nutritionally balanced, and palatable foods made from traditional millets.
niist.description: A process to convert millet grits (pearl, little, barnyard, kodo, foxtail) and arrowroot powder into a Ready-to-Eat (RTE) porridge. The technology utilizes pressure steaming, drying, and optimized formulation to deliver a nutrient-rich and palatable food product.
applications: • Manufacturing of instant ready-to-eat millet breakfast cereals • Production of commercially packaged therapeutic porridges • Processing of balanced nutritional mixes for health programs • Formulation of instant dry food bases reconstitutable with milk or water

niist.technology_name: Dehydrated Coconut Gravy Technology
niist.institution: CSIR-National Institute for Interdisciplinary Science and Technology (NIIST)
niist.problem_solved: Time-consuming preparation of traditional Indian dishes and the need to retain fresh flavors in instant foods.
niist.description: A technology to produce ready-to-constitute dehydrated coconut gravy mixed with spices such as chili, turmeric, mango, cumin, and jeera. The process uses a developed drying technology, RADD, and size reduction devices to create instant culinary bases.
applications: • Manufacturing of instant ready-to-cook traditional gravy mixes • Production of shelf-stable commercial culinary pastes and bases • Processing of dehydrated coconut and spice culinary products • Formulation of quick-prep institutional catering ingredients

niist.technology_name: Organic Potting Filler Formulation (COCONURTURE)
niist.institution: National Coir Research & Management Institute (NCRMI)
niist.problem_solved: Addresses poor aeration, water retention issues, and soil-borne diseases in plant cultivation and nursery environments.
niist.description: COCONURTURE is an organic potting filler formulated by blending crushed tender coconut husks, coir pith compost, farmyard manure, Trichoderma, and soil in precise proportions. The formulation was developed based on field trials conducted by the National Coir Research and Management Institute (NCRMI).
applications: • Manufacturing of commercial organic potting mixes • Production of bio-enriched nursery growing media • Deployment in commercial greenhouse and horticulture cultivation • Formulation of soil-less agricultural substrates • Processing of coir industry by-products into agricultural inputs

niist.technology_name: Coir Pith Carbon Bio-Briquette (PEATKOL Dots) Technology
niist.institution: National Coir Research & Management Institute (NCRMI)
niist.problem_solved: Environmental pollution from traditional coal and charcoal, and the need for sustainable utilization of coir pith biomass.
niist.description: A process for producing lightweight carbon bio-briquettes, named PEATKOL Dots, by strongly heating coirpith with limited air. The formulation utilizes the lignin in coirpith, which carbonizes to provide strength to the briquettes, creating an alternative fuel resource.
applications: • Manufacturing of eco-friendly commercial grilling and barbecue fuels • Production of natural incense and dhoop burning bases • Processing of agricultural coir pith waste into renewable energy briquettes • Deployment in commercial indoor and outdoor heating applications

niist.technology_name: éCoir Bag (Treated Coir Grow Bag) Technology
niist.institution: National Coir Research & Management Institute (NCRMI)
niist.problem_solved: Plastic grow bags restrict root growth, cause root circling, and create environmental pollution due to non-biodegradability.
niist.description: éCoir BAG is an eco-friendly, breathable grow bag developed jointly by NCRMI and FOMIL as an alternative to plastic grow bags. Made from specially treated coir without using rubber latex, the bags facilitate "air pruning" of roots, prevent root circling, and provide insulation. They measure 27 cm x 27 cm.
applications: • Manufacturing of eco-friendly agricultural grow bags • Production of biodegradable nursery and greenhouse planters • Deployment in urban terrace and indoor gardening • Processing of treated coir fiber into sustainable horticultural products

cpcri.technology_name: Kalpa Vermiwash Liquid Organic Fertilizer Technology
cpcri.problem_solved: Need for liquid organic fertilizers suitable for field and horticultural crops.
cpcri.description: Kalpa Vermiwash is a liquid organic fertilizer extracted from the active vermicomposting of coconut leaves. The liquid fertilizer is designed to be diluted and applied to field and horticultural crops, particularly vegetables.
startup_potential: • Manufacturing of liquid organic fertilizers • Production of agricultural bio-stimulants • Commercial vegetable cultivation inputs
cpcri.key_benefits_&_value_proposition: • Provides a liquid organic fertilizer extracted from active vermicomposting. • Can be applied to field and horticultural crops, particularly vegetables.

cpcri.problem_solved: Need for safe germplasm exchange and propagation of special types of coconut.
cpcri.description: The ICAR-CPCRI embryo culture protocol permits safe germplasm exchange. It helps in the propagation of special types of coconut, specifically soft and sweet endosperm types.
startup_potential: • Commercial agricultural propagation facilities • Production of specialized coconut varieties • Deployment in plant tissue culture laboratories
cpcri.key_benefits_&_value_proposition: • Permits safe germplasm exchange. • Helps in propagation of special types of coconut like soft and sweet endosperm types.

cpcri.problem_solved: Need to retrieve and utilize pollen from high yielding palms for breeding programmes.
cpcri.description: A simple and user-friendly protocol developed at ICAR-CPCRI for the cryopreservation of coconut pollen. Pollen collected from desiccated male flowers of high yielding palms can be retrieved and utilized in breeding programmes as and when required.
startup_potential: • Commercial agricultural breeding programs • Operation of plant genetic resource banks • Deployment in crop improvement facilities
cpcri.key_benefits_&_value_proposition: • Simple and user-friendly protocol. • Enables retrieval and utilization of pollen from high yielding palms in breeding programmes as required.

cpcri.technology_name: Coconut Immature Inflorescence Tissue Culture Protocol
cpcri.problem_solved: Need to produce uniform clones of elite coconut palms.
cpcri.description: The immature inflorescence tissue culture protocol is designed to produce uniform clones of elite palms.
startup_potential: • Mass multiplication of elite agricultural crops • Commercial operation of plant tissue culture labs • Production of uniform planting materials
cpcri.key_benefits_&_value_proposition: • Can produce uniform clones of elite palms.

cpcri.technology_name: Arecanut Immature Inflorescence Tissue Culture Protocol
cpcri.problem_solved: Need for mass multiplication of dwarf areca hybrids and YLD disease resistant palms.
cpcri.description: This protocol enables the mass multiplication of dwarf areca hybrids and YLD disease resistant palms.
startup_potential: • Commercial mass multiplication of arecanut hybrids • Production of disease-resistant agricultural planting materials
cpcri.key_benefits_&_value_proposition: • Enables mass multiplication of dwarf areca hybrids. • Enables multiplication of YLD disease resistant palms.

cpcri.technology_name: Molecular-Marker Based Coconut Hybrid Confirmation Technology
cpcri.problem_solved: Need to confirm the hybrid nature of seedlings in the nursery itself to ensure supply of genuine hybrids to farmers.
cpcri.description: Microsatellite markers developed at ICAR-CPCRI assist in screening the progenies from the crosses of parental palms to confirm their hybrid nature in the nursery itself. The use of these markers will ensure the supply of genuine hybrid seedlings to farmers.
startup_potential: • Commercial agricultural diagnostic screening • Quality control in plant nurseries • Manufacturing of agricultural genetic testing kits
cpcri.key_benefits_&_value_proposition: • Assists in screening progenies to confirm hybrid nature in the nursery itself. • Ensures supply of genuine hybrid seedlings to farmers.

cpcri.technology_name: Kalpa EPN (CPCRI - SC1) Aqua Formulation Technology
cpcri.problem_solved: Need for mass multiplication of dwarf areca hybrids and YLD disease resistant palms.
cpcri.description: This protocol enables mass multiplication of dwarf areca hybrids and YLD disease resistant palms.
startup_potential: • Commercial mass multiplication of agricultural hybrids • Production of disease-resistant planting materials
cpcri.key_benefits_&_value_proposition: • Enables mass multiplication of dwarf areca hybrids. • Enables multiplication of YLD disease resistant palms.

cpcri.technology_name: Trichoderma harzianum (CPTD28) Coir Pith Cake Technology
cpcri.problem_solved: Need for prophylactic treatment against bud rot and management of stem canker and soil-borne diseases.
cpcri.description: A simple and low-cost technology for producing Trichoderma coir pith cakes with a shelf life of one year. The formulation is very easy to handle and apply in the crowns of coconut palms as a prophylactic treatment against bud rot, in the management of stem canker of cocoa, and also for the management of soil-borne diseases in potted plants.
startup_potential: • Manufacturing of organic agricultural biocontrol agents • Production of prophylactic treatments for plantation crops • Commercial nursery disease management
cpcri.key_benefits_&_value_proposition: • Simple and low-cost technology. • Formulation has a shelf life of one year. • Easy to handle and apply as a prophylactic treatment.

cpcri.technology_name: Trichoderma harzianum Mass Production on Areca Leaf Sheath
cpcri.problem_solved: Need for rapid mass production of Trichoderma for eco-friendly disease management.
cpcri.description: A very simple, cost-effective technology for the rapid mass production of Trichoderma harzianum (CPTD 28) utilizing areca leaf sheath. The Trichoderma enriched areca leaf sheath can be effectively utilized for the eco-friendly management of stem bleeding and basal stem rot diseases of coconut and also for quick wilt disease of black pepper.
startup_potential: • Industrial-scale manufacturing of agricultural biopesticides • Production of eco-friendly disease management inputs • Deployment in plantation crop protection programs
cpcri.key_benefits_&_value_proposition: • Very simple and cost-effective technology for rapid mass production. • Provides eco-friendly management of stem bleeding, basal stem rot, and quick wilt disease.
